rules.explanation_en: Use a greeting that fits the time of day. Good night is only used when leaving or going to bed.
rules.explanation_ar: استخدم التحية المناسبة لوقت اليوم. عبارة Good night تُقال فقط عند الوداع أو قبل النوم.
rules.syntax: Greeting + (name).

rules.explanation_en: Use short fixed phrases to say goodbye and to ask how someone is.
rules.explanation_ar: عبارات ثابتة قصيرة للوداع وللسؤال عن الحال.
rules.syntax: See you + time. / How are you? -> I'm + adjective.

examples.en: How are you? I'm fine, thanks.

lessons.title: The Alphabet and Spelling Your Name

rules.explanation_en: Use 'How do you spell...?' to ask for the letters of a word. Say each letter separately.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم 'How do you spell...?' لنسأل عن حروف الكلمة، وننطق كل حرف على حدة.
rules.syntax: How do you spell + word? -> It's + letters.

examples.en: How do you spell cat? It's C-A-T.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة cat؟ هي C-A-T.

examples.en: How do you spell book? It's B-O-O-K.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة book؟ هي B-O-O-K.

examples.en: How do you spell your name? It's S-A-M.
How do you spell apple? It's A-P-P-L-E.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة apple؟ هي A-P-P-L-E.

examples.en: How do you spell sun? It's S-U-N.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة sun؟ هي S-U-N.

examples.en: How do you spell dog? It's D-O-G.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة dog؟ هي D-O-G.

examples.en: How do you spell school? It's S-C-H-O-O-L.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة school؟ هي S-C-H-O-O-L.

examples.en: How do you spell mother? It's M-O-T-H-E-R.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة mother؟ هي M-O-T-H-E-R.

examples.en: How do you spell water? It's W-A-T-E-R.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى كلمة water؟ هي W-A-T-E-R.

examples.en: How do you spell Ahmed? It's A-H-M-E-D.
examples.ar: كيف تتهجى اسم Ahmed؟ هو A-H-M-E-D.

rules.rule: Vowels, double letters and capital letters
rules.explanation_en: A, E, I, O, U are vowels. Say 'double' for two same letters. Use a capital letter for names, countries, days, months and the word I.
rules.explanation_ar: الحروف A E I O U حروف علة. نقول double للحرفين المتشابهين. نكتب بحرف كبير الأسماء والدول والأيام والأشهر وكلمة I.
rules.syntax: Capital letter: names, countries, cities, days, months, I.

examples.en: A, E, I, O and U are vowels.
examples.ar: الحروف A و E و I و O و U حروف علة.
كلمة Hello فيها حرف L مزدوج.

examples.en: Egypt starts with a capital E.
examples.ar: كلمة Egypt تبدأ بحرف E كبير.

examples.en: Monday is a day of the week.
Coffee has a double F and a double E.
examples.ar: كلمة coffee فيها F مزدوج و E مزدوج.

examples.en: Balloon has a double L and a double O.
examples.ar: كلمة balloon فيها L مزدوج و O مزدوج.

rules.explanation_en: Numbers 13-19 end in -teen (stress at the end). Tens like 30, 40 end in -ty (stress at the start). After a number bigger than one, the noun is plural.
rules.explanation_ar: الأرقام 13-19 تنتهي بـ teen والنبر في الآخر. والعشرات 30 و40 تنتهي بـ ty والنبر في الأول. بعد أي رقم أكبر من واحد يكون الاسم جمعًا.
rules.syntax: number + plural noun (one + singular noun).

rules.explanation_en: Use a hyphen between tens and units (twenty-one). 100 is a hundred or one hundred.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الشرطة بين العشرات والآحاد (twenty-one). الرقم 100 يُقال a hundred أو one hundred.
rules.syntax: tens + hyphen + unit (twenty-one).

rules.explanation_en: An imperative gives an instruction. Use the base verb. There is no subject. Add Don't for a negative command.
rules.explanation_ar: فعل الأمر يعطي تعليمات. نستخدم الفعل في صورته الأساسية بدون فاعل. وللنهي نضيف Don't.
rules.syntax: Base verb + object. / Don't + base verb.

rules.explanation_en: Use this and these for things near you. Use that and those for things far from you. This and that are singular. These and those are plural.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم this و these للأشياء القريبة، و that و those للأشياء البعيدة. this و that للمفرد، و these و those للجمع.
rules.syntax: This/That + is + singular noun. These/Those + are + plural noun.

lessons.title: Subject Pronouns and the Verb To Be

rules.explanation_en: Pronouns replace nouns. I, you, he, she, it are singular (you can also be plural). We, you, they are plural. Use it for things, animals and weather.
rules.explanation_ar: الضمائر تحل محل الأسماء. I و he و she و it للمفرد، و we و they للجمع، و you للمفرد والجمع. نستخدم it للأشياء والحيوانات والطقس.
rules.syntax: Subject pronoun + verb.

rules.explanation_en: I uses am. He, she, it and singular nouns use is. You, we, they and plural nouns use are.
rules.explanation_ar: I مع am. و he و she و it والأسماء المفردة مع is. و you و we و they والأسماء الجمع مع are.
rules.syntax: Subject + am/is/are + complement.

examples.en: The children are in the garden.

rules.explanation_en: Add not after am/is/are for the negative. For a question, put am/is/are before the subject.
rules.explanation_ar: للنفي نضيف not بعد am/is/are. وللسؤال نضع am/is/are قبل الفاعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + not. / Be + subject + complement?

rules.explanation_en: Use be + from + country. Country names start with a capital letter.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم be + from + اسم الدولة. وأسماء الدول تبدأ بحرف كبير.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + from + country.

rules.explanation_en: Nationality words also start with a capital letter. Common endings are -an, -ish, -ese and -i.
rules.explanation_ar: كلمات الجنسيات تبدأ أيضًا بحرف كبير. ومن نهاياتها الشائعة an و ish و ese و i.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + nationality.

rules.explanation_en: Possessive adjectives show who owns something. They come before a noun and do not change for singular or plural nouns.
rules.explanation_ar: صفات الملكية توضح صاحب الشيء. تأتي قبل الاسم ولا تتغير مع المفرد أو الجمع.
rules.syntax: my/your/his/her/its/our/their + noun.

rules.explanation_en: Use What, How old and Where to ask for details. Age uses be (I am 20), not have.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم What و How old و Where للسؤال عن التفاصيل. والعمر يستخدم be (I am 20) وليس have.
rules.syntax: What + be + your + noun? / How old + be + subject?

rules.explanation_en: Wh- words ask for information: What (thing), Who (person), Where (place), When (time), How (way), Which (choice).
rules.explanation_ar: كلمات الاستفهام تسأل عن معلومة: What للشيء و Who للشخص و Where للمكان و When للوقت و How للكيفية و Which للاختيار.
rules.syntax: Wh- word + be + subject?

rules.explanation_en: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound. Use them only with singular nouns.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم a قبل صوت ساكن، و an قبل صوت متحرك. ونستخدمهما مع الاسم المفرد فقط.
rules.syntax: a + consonant sound / an + vowel sound + singular noun.

rules.rule: Affirmative: add -s for he / she / it
rules.explanation_en: Use the present simple for habits, routines and facts. With he, she and it, add -s (or -es / -ies) to the verb.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات والروتين والحقائق. مع he و she و it نضيف s (أو es / ies) للفعل.
rules.syntax: I/you/we/they + verb. He/she/it + verb + s.

rules.explanation_en: Use do not (don't) with I, you, we, they. Use does not (doesn't) with he, she, it. The main verb stays in the base form.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم don't مع I و you و we و they، و doesn't مع he و she و it. ويبقى الفعل الأساسي بدون s.
rules.syntax: Subject + don't/doesn't + base verb.

examples.en: The shop doesn't open on Friday.

rules.explanation_en: Start a question with Do or Does. After does, the verb has no -s. Answer with Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
rules.explanation_ar: نبدأ السؤال بـ Do أو Does. وبعد does لا نضيف s للفعل. ونجيب بـ Yes, I do. أو No, she doesn't.
rules.syntax: Do/Does + subject + base verb?

examples.en: Does he work in a bank?
Does the shop open at nine?

rules.explanation_en: Use at with clock times and in the morning / afternoon / evening, but at night.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم at مع الساعة، و in the morning / afternoon / evening مع أجزاء اليوم، لكن at night مع الليل.
rules.syntax: Subject + verb + at + time.

examples.en: He goes to work at eight.
examples.ar: هو يذهب إلى العمل في الثامنة.
هم يعودون إلى المنزل في الخامسة.

examples.en: I take a shower in the morning.
She watches TV in the evening.
He goes to bed at ten.
My father starts work at nine.

rules.explanation_en: Use first, then, after that, next and finally to put actions in order. Put a comma after first, after that and finally.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم first و then و after that و next و finally لترتيب الأحداث. ونضع فاصلة بعد first و after that و finally.
rules.syntax: Sequence word, + subject + verb.

rules.explanation_en: Use It's to tell the time. Say o'clock for exact hours, past for minutes after the hour, and to for minutes before the next hour.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم It's لقول الوقت. نقول o'clock للساعة بالضبط، و past للدقائق بعد الساعة، و to للدقائق قبل الساعة التالية.
rules.syntax: It's + time.

rules.explanation_en: Use at before a clock time. Use a.m. for morning and p.m. for afternoon and evening.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم at قبل الوقت. ونستخدم a.m. للصباح و p.m. للمساء.
rules.syntax: What time + do/does + subject + verb? -> Subject + verb + at + time.

examples.en: I get up at half past six.
The bus comes at quarter past eight.
What time do you eat lunch?
I eat lunch at one o'clock.

rules.rule: on / in with days and months
rules.explanation_en: Use on with days (on Monday) and in with months (in May). There are 7 days in a week and 12 months in a year.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم on مع الأيام (on Monday) و in مع الأشهر (in May). في الأسبوع 7 أيام وفي السنة 12 شهرًا.
rules.syntax: on + day / in + month.

examples.en: There are twelve months in a year.
examples.ar: هناك اثنا عشر شهرًا في السنة.

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.

rules.explanation_en: Always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely and never say how often. Put them before the main verb but after be.
rules.explanation_ar: always و usually و often و sometimes و rarely و never تبين عدد مرات الحدوث. نضعها قبل الفعل الأساسي وبعد فعل be.
rules.syntax: Subject + adverb + verb. / Subject + be + adverb.

rules.explanation_en: Add 's to a singular noun and an apostrophe after the s of a regular plural noun. Irregular plurals (children) take 's.
rules.explanation_ar: نضيف 's للاسم المفرد، ونضيف الفاصلة العليا بعد s في الجمع المنتظم. وجمع الشواذ مثل children يأخذ 's.
rules.syntax: owner's + thing. / owners' + thing.

examples.en: Sam's book is on the table.
The students' books are on the desk.

rules.explanation_en: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours and theirs stand alone, with no noun after them. Use Whose to ask who owns something.
rules.explanation_ar: mine و yours و his و hers و ours و theirs تأتي وحدها بدون اسم بعدها. ونستخدم Whose للسؤال عن المالك.
rules.syntax: Whose + noun + be + this/these? -> It's/They're + pronoun.

rules.explanation_en: Some nouns have special plural forms: man - men, woman - women, child - children, person - people, baby - babies.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الأسماء لها جمع خاص: man - men و woman - women و child - children و person - people و baby - babies.
rules.syntax: one + singular noun. / two or more + plural noun.

rules.explanation_en: Parents is always plural. Family is singular. Use How many + plural noun to ask about numbers.
rules.explanation_ar: كلمة parents جمع دائمًا. وكلمة family مفرد. نستخدم How many + اسم جمع للسؤال عن العدد.
rules.syntax: How many + plural noun + do you have?

examples.en: How many sisters do you have?

rules.rule: Adjectives with be and before nouns
rules.explanation_en: Adjectives describe people. They come after be or before a noun. They never take -s.
rules.explanation_ar: الصفات تصف الأشخاص. تأتي بعد be أو قبل الاسم. ولا تأخذ s أبدًا.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + adjective. / a/an + adjective + noun.

rules.rule: Describing looks with have and look like
rules.explanation_en: Use have/has for hair and eyes. Use What does he look like? for appearance and What is he like? for personality.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has للشعر والعينين. ونستخدم What does he look like? للشكل و What is he like? للشخصية.
rules.syntax: Subject + have/has + adjective + hair/eyes.

examples.en: He is tall with dark hair.
What is she like? She is kind.

rules.explanation_en: Use have with I, you, we, they. Use has with he, she, it.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have مع I و you و we و they، و has مع he و she و it.
rules.syntax: I/you/we/they + have. He/she/it + has.

rules.explanation_en: Use don't/doesn't + have for the negative. Use Do/Does + subject + have for questions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم don't/doesn't + have للنفي. ونستخدم Do/Does + الفاعل + have للسؤال.
rules.syntax: Subject + don't/doesn't + have. / Do/Does + subject + have?

examples.en: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.

rules.explanation_en: Most nouns add -s. Nouns ending in -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o add -es. Consonant + y becomes -ies. Nouns ending in -f / -fe change to -ves. Some are irregular.
rules.explanation_ar: معظم الأسماء تضيف s. والأسماء المنتهية بـ s و sh و ch و x و o تضيف es. وحرف y بعد ساكن يصبح ies. والمنتهية بـ f أو fe تصبح ves. وبعضها شاذ.
rules.syntax: singular + s / es / ies / ves.

rules.explanation_en: Use some in affirmative sentences and in offers or requests. Use any in negatives and questions. Uncountable nouns have no plural.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم some في الجمل المثبتة وفي العروض والطلبات. ونستخدم any في النفي والأسئلة. والأسماء غير المعدودة ليس لها جمع.
rules.syntax: some + noun (+). / not any + noun (-). / any + noun? (?).

examples.en: Can I have some water, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على بعض الماء من فضلك؟

rules.explanation_en: To count uncountable food and drink, use a container word + of. Make the container plural, not the food.
rules.explanation_ar: لعد الطعام والشراب غير المعدود نستخدم كلمة وعاء + of. ونجمع الوعاء وليس الطعام.
rules.syntax: a/number + container + of + uncountable noun.

examples.en: I want a glass of water.
She drinks a cup of tea.
He buys a bottle of milk.
We need a kilo of rice.
I eat a slice of bread.
She has a packet of biscuits.
I drink two glasses of juice.
They buy three bottles of water.
He eats a bowl of soup.
Give me a piece of cake.

rules.explanation_en: Use how many and many with countable nouns. Use how much and much with uncountable nouns. Much and many are mostly used in negatives and questions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم how many و many مع المعدود، و how much و much مع غير المعدود. وتُستخدم much و many غالبًا في النفي والأسئلة.
rules.syntax: How many + plural noun? / How much + uncountable noun?

examples.en: How many apples do you want?
How much rice do you want?

rules.rule: I'd like and Can I have...?
rules.explanation_en: I'd like means I would like. It is a polite way to ask for something. Can I have...? is also polite.
rules.explanation_ar: I'd like تعني I would like، وهي طريقة مهذبة للطلب. وCan I have...? أيضًا مهذبة.
rules.syntax: I'd like + noun. / Can I have + noun, please?

examples.en: Can I have the menu, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على القائمة من فضلك؟

examples.en: Can I have a glass of juice?
examples.ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على كوب عصير؟

examples.en: Can we have two teas, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكننا الحصول على شايين من فضلك؟

examples.en: Can I have the bill, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على الفاتورة من فضلك؟

examples.en: I'd like a pizza and a cola.

rules.explanation_en: Use Would you like...? to offer something politely. Answer with Yes, please. or No, thank you.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم Would you like...? لتقديم عرض بأدب. ونجيب بـ Yes, please. أو No, thank you.
rules.syntax: Would + subject + like + noun / to + verb?

examples.en: Would you like coffee or tea?
Would you like some more rice?
Would you like to sit here?

rules.explanation_en: Use How much is for one thing and How much are for plural things. Answer with It is... or They are...
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم How much is للشيء الواحد و How much are للأشياء المتعددة. ونجيب بـ It is... أو They are...
rules.syntax: How much + is/are + noun? -> It is / They are + price.

examples.en: They are ten riyals a kilo.
How much is a cup of tea?

rules.explanation_en: Use costs with a singular subject and cost with a plural subject. Money is uncountable.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم costs مع الفاعل المفرد و cost مع الفاعل الجمع. وكلمة money غير معدودة.
rules.syntax: Singular subject + costs + price. / Plural subject + cost + price.

examples.en: These bags cost a hundred riyals.
How much money do you have?

rules.explanation_en: Use there is for one thing or an uncountable noun. Use there are for plural nouns. They say that something exists.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم there is للشيء الواحد أو غير المعدود، و there are للجمع. وهما تدلان على وجود شيء.
rules.syntax: There is + a/an + singular noun. / There are + plural noun.

examples.en: There is a bank near here.
There is a book on the table.
There is some milk in the fridge.
There are two chairs in the room.
There are many shops in the city.
There is a park in my town.
There are five students in class.
There is a cat under the bed.

rules.rule: There is / are: negative and questions
rules.explanation_en: Use isn't / aren't for the negative and any with plural or uncountable nouns. For questions, put Is or Are before there.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم isn't / aren't للنفي مع any للجمع وغير المعدود. وللسؤال نضع Is أو Are قبل there.
rules.syntax: There isn't/aren't (any)... / Is/Are there (any)...?

examples.en: There aren't any shops near here.
examples.ar: لا توجد محلات قريبة من هنا.

examples.en: Is there a school near here?

rules.explanation_en: Use in for inside something, on for a surface, and at for a point or a place like home, school or the door.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم in للداخل، و on للسطح، و at لنقطة أو مكان مثل المنزل والمدرسة والباب.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + in/on/at + place.

examples.en: The book is on the table.
The cat is in the box.
The picture is on the wall.
My phone is in my bag.
The keys are on the desk.
The students are in the classroom.

rules.rule: next to, between, under, in front of, behind, opposite
rules.explanation_en: These prepositions say exactly where something is. Between is used for two things.
rules.explanation_ar: حروف الجر هذه تحدد مكان الشيء بالضبط. وتُستخدم between مع شيئين.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + preposition + the + noun.

examples.en: The bank is next to the school.
The cat is under the table.
The lamp is above the bed.
The shop is between the bank and the cafe.
The car is in front of the house.
The garden is behind the house.
The post office is opposite the park.
The bag is beside the chair.
The ball is near the door.
The clock is over the door.

rules.explanation_en: Most place nouns add -s. Nouns ending in -s add -es (bus - buses). Consonant + y becomes -ies (pharmacy - pharmacies).
rules.explanation_ar: معظم أسماء الأماكن تضيف s. والمنتهية بـ s تضيف es (bus - buses). وحرف y بعد ساكن يصبح ies (pharmacy - pharmacies).
rules.syntax: a + singular noun. / number + plural noun.

examples.en: There are two hospitals in the city.

rules.explanation_en: Use Is there a...? to ask if a place exists. Use Where is the...? when you know which place.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم Is there a...? للسؤال عن وجود مكان. ونستخدم Where is the...? عندما نعرف المكان المقصود.
rules.syntax: Is there a + noun + near here? / Where is the + noun?

examples.en: Is there a bank near here?
examples.ar: هل يوجد بنك قريب من هنا؟

examples.en: The library is on Main Street.
The hospital is far from here.
The park is near my house.
There is a bakery on the corner.

rules.explanation_en: Use the base verb to give directions. Use on your left / on your right to say where a place is.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الفعل الأساسي لإعطاء الاتجاهات. ونستخدم on your left / on your right لتحديد مكان الشيء.
rules.syntax: Base verb + direction. (Turn left. Go straight on.)

examples.en: Take the first street on the left.
Take the second street on the right.

rules.explanation_en: Start with Excuse me. Use Where is...? or How do I get to...? Finish with a polite thank you.
rules.explanation_ar: نبدأ بـ Excuse me. ونستخدم Where is...? أو How do I get to...? وننهي بشكر مهذب.
rules.syntax: Excuse me, where is + place? / How do I get to + place?

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
How do I get to the park?

rules.explanation_en: Can shows ability. It is the same for every subject: no -s, and the next verb is in the base form.
rules.explanation_ar: can تدل على القدرة. وهي نفسها مع كل الفواعل: بدون s، والفعل بعدها في صورته الأساسية.
rules.syntax: Subject + can + base verb.

rules.explanation_en: The negative is can't (cannot). For questions, put Can before the subject. Answer with Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
rules.explanation_ar: النفي can't (cannot). وللسؤال نضع Can قبل الفاعل. ونجيب بـ Yes, I can. أو No, I can't.
rules.syntax: Subject + can't + verb. / Can + subject + verb?

examples.en: Yes, I can. No, I can't.

rules.rule: play, go and do with activities
rules.explanation_en: Use play with sports with a ball, games and instruments. Use go + -ing for activities like swimming. Use do for activities like yoga.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم play مع رياضات الكرة والألعاب والآلات الموسيقية، و go + ing للأنشطة مثل السباحة، و do لأنشطة مثل اليوغا.
rules.syntax: play + sport/game. / go + verb-ing. / do + activity.

rules.explanation_en: For general likes, use a plural or uncountable noun with no article: I like movies, I like music.
rules.explanation_ar: للتعبير عن الأشياء التي نحبها بشكل عام نستخدم اسمًا جمعًا أو غير معدود بدون أداة تعريف: I like movies و I like music.
rules.syntax: Subject + like(s) + plural/uncountable noun.

examples.en: What do you do in your free time?

lessons.title: Like, Love, Hate + -ing
lessons.title_ar: Like و Love و Hate + ing

rules.explanation_en: After like, love and hate, use the -ing form of the verb. With he/she/it, add -s to like, not to the -ing verb.
rules.explanation_ar: بعد like و love و hate نستخدم الفعل بصيغة ing. ومع he/she/it نضيف s إلى like وليس إلى فعل ing.
rules.syntax: Subject + like/love/hate + verb-ing.

rules.explanation_en: Use me, you, him, her, it, us, them after a verb or a preposition.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم me و you و him و her و it و us و them بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر.
rules.syntax: Subject + verb + object pronoun.

rules.explanation_en: Put the helping verb (be, do, does, can) before the subject. The main verb stays in the base form after do/does/can.
rules.explanation_ar: نضع الفعل المساعد (be أو do أو does أو can) قبل الفاعل. ويبقى الفعل الأساسي في صورته الأساسية بعد do/does/can.
rules.syntax: Be/Do/Does/Can + subject + (verb)?

rules.explanation_en: Put the question word first, then the helping verb, then the subject. When Who is the subject, do not use do/does.
rules.explanation_ar: نضع كلمة الاستفهام أولًا ثم الفعل المساعد ثم الفاعل. وعندما تكون Who هي الفاعل لا نستخدم do/does.
rules.syntax: Wh- word + do/does/be + subject + verb?

examples.en: How do you go to work?
What time does he get up?

rules.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for actions happening now. Time words: now, at the moment, today.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + فعل ing للأحداث التي تحدث الآن. وكلمات الوقت: now و at the moment و today.
rules.syntax: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing.

rules.explanation_en: Add not after am/is/are for the negative. Put am/is/are before the subject for questions.
rules.explanation_ar: نضيف not بعد am/is/are للنفي. ونضع am/is/are قبل الفاعل للسؤال.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + not + verb-ing. / Be + subject + verb-ing?

rules.explanation_en: Use it as the subject for weather. Use adjectives (sunny, cold) or -ing verbs (raining, snowing).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم it كفاعل للحديث عن الطقس. ونستخدم صفات (sunny و cold) أو أفعالًا بصيغة ing (raining و snowing).
rules.syntax: It + is + adjective. / It + is + verb-ing.

rules.explanation_en: Use in before a season (in summer). The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn and winter.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم in قبل الفصل (in summer). والفصول الأربعة هي spring و summer و autumn و winter.
rules.syntax: in + season.

examples.en: It rains a lot in winter.
We go to the beach in summer.

rules.explanation_en: Was and were are the past of be. Use was with I, he, she, it. Use were with you, we, they.
rules.explanation_ar: was و were هما ماضي be. نستخدم was مع I و he و she و it، و were مع you و we و they.
rules.syntax: I/he/she/it + was. You/we/they + were.

rules.rule: Was and were: negative and questions
rules.explanation_en: The negatives are wasn't and weren't. For questions, put Was or Were before the subject.
rules.explanation_ar: النفي wasn't و weren't. وللسؤال نضع Was أو Were قبل الفاعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + wasn't/weren't. / Was/Were + subject?

rules.explanation_en: Use yesterday, last week, last year and ago with the past. Ago comes after the time: two days ago.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم yesterday و last week و last year و ago مع الماضي. وتأتي ago بعد الزمن: two days ago.
rules.syntax: Subject + was/were + place/adjective + time expression.

examples.en: We were at the beach last week.
She was ill two days ago.
He was in Cairo last year.

examples.ar: كان الجو مشمسًا يوم الاثنين الماضي.

rules.explanation_en: Review all A1 patterns: to be, have, can, present simple, there is/are, present continuous and was/were.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة كل أنماط A1: to be و have و can والمضارع البسيط و there is/are والمضارع المستمر و was/were.
rules.syntax: Choose the pattern that fits the meaning.

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.

rules.explanation_en: Use the past simple for finished actions. Add -ed to regular verbs. The form is the same for every subject.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط للأحداث التي انتهت. نضيف ed للأفعال المنتظمة، والصيغة واحدة مع كل الفواعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + verb-ed + (object) + (time).

rules.explanation_en: Verbs ending in -e add -d. Consonant + y changes to -ied. One-syllable verbs with consonant-vowel-consonant double the last letter.
rules.explanation_ar: الأفعال المنتهية بـ e تضيف d فقط. وy بعد ساكن تتحول إلى ied. والأفعال القصيرة (ساكن-متحرك-ساكن) نضاعف حرفها الأخير.
rules.syntax: like -> liked, study -> studied, stop -> stopped.

rules.explanation_en: Irregular verbs do not take -ed. You must learn their past forms: go - went, have - had, see - saw, eat - ate.
rules.explanation_ar: الأفعال الشاذة لا تأخذ ed، ويجب حفظ صيغة الماضي لكل منها: go - went و have - had و see - saw و eat - ate.
rules.syntax: Subject + irregular past form + object.

rules.explanation_en: More irregular verbs to learn: get - got, give - gave, know - knew, say - said, sit - sat, run - ran, swim - swam, sleep - slept, meet - met, read - read.
rules.explanation_ar: المزيد من الأفعال الشاذة: get - got و give - gave و know - knew و say - said و sit - sat و run - ran و swim - swam و sleep - slept و meet - met و read - read.
rules.syntax: Subject + irregular past form + object.

rules.explanation_en: Use didn't (did not) + the base verb for all subjects. The main verb does not take -ed.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم didn't (did not) + الفعل الأساسي مع كل الفواعل. والفعل الرئيسي لا يأخذ ed.
rules.syntax: Subject + didn't + base verb.

rules.explanation_en: Start questions with Did. The main verb is in the base form. Answer with Yes, I did. or No, I didn't.
rules.explanation_ar: نبدأ الأسئلة بـ Did والفعل الرئيسي في صورته الأساسية. ونجيب بـ Yes, I did. أو No, I didn't.
rules.syntax: (Wh- word) + did + subject + base verb?

examples.en: Yes, I did. No, I didn't.

lessons.title: Time Expressions and Telling a Story

rules.explanation_en: Use yesterday, last week/month/year, ago, in + year, on + day and this morning with the past simple. Ago comes after the time.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم yesterday و last week/month/year و ago و in + سنة و on + يوم و this morning مع الماضي البسيط. وتأتي ago بعد الزمن.
rules.syntax: Subject + past verb + time expression.

examples.en: I went to Cairo last year.

rules.rule: Linking words: and, but, because, so, then
rules.explanation_en: And adds ideas, but shows contrast, because gives a reason, so gives a result, then shows the next action.
rules.explanation_ar: and للإضافة و but للتعارض و because للسبب و so للنتيجة و then للحدث التالي.
rules.syntax: Sentence 1 + , so/but + sentence 2. / Sentence + because + reason.

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed.
She stayed home because it rained.
examples.ar: بقيت في المنزل لأن السماء أمطرت.

examples.en: We ate and then we left.
He wanted to go, but he was busy.
I opened the door and went in.
First we ate, then we walked.
She was hungry, so she cooked.
They missed the bus because they were late.

rules.explanation_en: Use be going to for plans you decided before speaking. Use am/is/are + going to + base verb.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم be going to للخطط التي قررناها قبل الكلام. نستخدم am/is/are + going to + الفعل الأساسي.
rules.syntax: Subject + am/is/are + going to + base verb.

examples.en: She's going to visit her aunt.
We're going to travel in summer.
He's going to buy a car.
My sister is going to start school.
We are going to have a party.
He is going to call you.

rules.rule: Going to: predictions, negatives and questions
rules.explanation_en: Going to is also used for predictions when you see evidence now. For the negative add not. For questions put am/is/are first.
rules.explanation_ar: تُستخدم going to أيضًا للتنبؤ عندما نرى دليلًا الآن. وللنفي نضيف not. وللسؤال نضع am/is/are أولًا.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + not + going to + verb. / Be + subject + going to + verb?

examples.en: Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.
We aren't going to eat out.
What are you going to do?
Where are they going to stay?
When is he going to arrive?

rules.rule: Will for decisions, offers and promises
rules.explanation_en: Use will for quick decisions, offers, promises and opinions about the future. The contraction is 'll.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم will للقرارات السريعة والعروض والوعود والآراء عن المستقبل. والاختصار 'll.
rules.syntax: Subject + will + base verb.

examples.en: I promise I'll be on time.

rules.explanation_en: The negative is will not (won't). For questions, put Will before the subject. Answer with Yes, I will. or No, I won't.
rules.explanation_ar: النفي will not (won't). وللسؤال نضع Will قبل الفاعل. ونجيب بـ Yes, I will. أو No, I won't.
rules.syntax: Subject + won't + verb. / Will + subject + verb?

examples.en: Yes, I will. No, I won't.

rules.explanation_en: Use Would you like to...? (polite) or Do you want to...? (informal) to invite someone.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم Would you like to...? (مهذب) أو Do you want to...? (غير رسمي) لدعوة شخص.
rules.syntax: Would you like to + verb? / Do you want to + verb?

examples.en: Would you like to have dinner?
Do you want to play football?
Do you want to come with us?
Would you like to see a film?
Do you want to go for a walk?
Would you like to join us?

rules.explanation_en: Accept with Yes, I'd love to. Decline politely with Sorry, I can't and give a reason.
rules.explanation_ar: نقبل بـ Yes, I'd love to. ونعتذر بأدب بـ Sorry, I can't مع ذكر السبب.
rules.syntax: Sorry, I can't. + reason. / Thanks, but + reason.

examples.en: Thanks, but I have to work.

rules.explanation_en: Use the present continuous with a future time for fixed arrangements: am/is/are + verb-ing + tomorrow/tonight/next week.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر مع زمن مستقبلي للترتيبات المؤكدة: am/is/are + فعل ing + tomorrow/tonight/next week.
rules.syntax: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing + future time.

examples.en: He's flying to Dubai on Monday.
She's seeing the doctor at ten.
What are you doing this weekend?
My parents are visiting us next week.

rules.rule: Let's, Shall we and Why don't we
rules.explanation_en: Use these to make suggestions. Let's + verb, Shall we + verb?, Why don't we + verb?, How about + noun/verb-ing?
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم هذه التعبيرات للاقتراحات: Let's + فعل و Shall we + فعل؟ و Why don't we + فعل؟ و How about + اسم/فعل ing؟
rules.syntax: Let's + verb. / Shall we + verb? / Why don't we + verb?

examples.en: Why don't we watch a film?

rules.explanation_en: Add -er to short adjectives and use than. Double the last letter after consonant-vowel-consonant (big - bigger). Change y to -ier (happy - happier).
rules.explanation_ar: نضيف er للصفات القصيرة ونستخدم than. ونضاعف الحرف الأخير (big - bigger). ونغير y إلى ier (happy - happier).
rules.syntax: A + be + adjective-er + than + B.

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
This bag is cheaper than that one.
My car is older than yours.
The train is faster than the bus.
She is younger than her sister.
This road is wider than that road.
The box is heavier than the bag.
My house is smaller than yours.

rules.explanation_en: Use more + adjective + than with long adjectives. Good - better and bad - worse are irregular.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم more + صفة + than مع الصفات الطويلة. و good - better و bad - worse صيغ شاذة.
rules.syntax: A + be + more + adjective + than + B.

examples.en: This phone is more expensive than that one.
English is more interesting than maths.
This book is more difficult than that one.
The film is more boring than the book.
Taxis are more comfortable than buses.
examples.ar: سيارات الأجرة أكثر راحة من الحافلات.

examples.en: Her car is better than mine.
The weather today is worse than yesterday.
This exercise is easier than that one.
She is more careful than me.

rules.explanation_en: Use the + adjective-est for the top of a group of three or more. Double the last letter (big - biggest) and change y to -iest.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم the + صفة est للأعلى بين ثلاثة أو أكثر. ونضاعف الحرف الأخير (big - biggest) ونغير y إلى iest.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + the + adjective-est (+ in/of + group).

examples.en: He is the tallest in the class.
The Nile is the longest river.
She is the happiest girl in the class.

rules.explanation_en: Use the most + long adjective. Good - the best and bad - the worst are irregular.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم the most + صفة طويلة. و good - the best و bad - the worst صيغ شاذة.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + the most + adjective.

examples.en: This is the most expensive phone.
It is the most beautiful city.
He is the most famous player.
This is the best restaurant in town.
She is the most interesting teacher.
It is the most popular sport.
This is the most difficult question.
What is the most important thing?

lessons.title: As ... as, Too and Enough
lessons.title_ar: As ... as و Too و Enough

rules.explanation_en: Use as...as to say two things are equal. Use not as...as to say one is less.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم as...as للتعبير عن التساوي بين شيئين، و not as...as للتعبير عن أن أحدهما أقل.
rules.syntax: A + be + as + adjective + as + B.

examples.en: He is as tall as me.
This bag is as expensive as that one.
She is as old as my sister.
My phone is not as new as yours.
Cairo isn't as hot as Riyadh.
The film wasn't as good as the book.
examples.ar: لم يكن الفيلم جيدًا مثل الكتاب.

examples.en: Tea is as good as coffee.
He runs as fast as his brother.
This room is as big as that one.

rules.explanation_en: Too means more than needed (a problem). Enough means as much as needed. Too goes before the adjective, enough goes after it.
rules.explanation_ar: too تعني أكثر من اللازم (مشكلة). و enough تعني بقدر الكفاية. too قبل الصفة و enough بعدها.
rules.syntax: too + adjective. / adjective + enough. / enough + noun.

examples.en: He is too tired to study.
She is old enough to drive.

rules.explanation_en: Use adjectives to describe places. They go after be or before the noun.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الصفات لوصف الأماكن. تأتي بعد be أو قبل الاسم.
rules.syntax: The + place + is + adjective. / It is a + adjective + place.

rules.rule: A lot of, a few, a little
rules.explanation_en: A lot of / lots of work with both. A few goes with plural countable nouns. A little goes with uncountable nouns. Use many/much in negatives and questions.
rules.explanation_ar: a lot of و lots of تعملان مع النوعين. و a few مع الجمع المعدود. و a little مع غير المعدود. ونستخدم many/much في النفي والأسئلة.
rules.syntax: a few + plural noun. / a little + uncountable noun.

examples.en: There are a lot of cars.
There is a lot of traffic.
We have a few friends here.

rules.explanation_en: Use have/has + past participle for experiences and for recent actions with a result now. Do not say when it happened.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has + التصريف الثالث للتجارب وللأحداث القريبة التي لها نتيجة الآن. ولا نذكر وقت حدوثها.
rules.syntax: Subject + have/has + past participle.

examples.en: We have lived here for years.
He has bought a new car.

rules.explanation_en: Use haven't/hasn't + past participle for the negative. For questions, put Have/Has before the subject.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم haven't/hasn't + التصريف الثالث للنفي. وللسؤال نضع Have/Has قبل الفاعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + haven't/hasn't + p.p. / Have/Has + subject + p.p.?

examples.en: Yes, I have. No, he hasn't.

lessons.title: Ever, Never, Already, Yet
lessons.title_ar: Ever و Never و Already و Yet

rules.explanation_en: Use ever in questions to ask about life experiences. Use never to say something has not happened in your life.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم ever في الأسئلة عن تجارب الحياة. ونستخدم never لنقول إن شيئًا لم يحدث في حياتنا أبدًا.
rules.syntax: Have you ever + p.p.? / I have never + p.p.

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
Has she ever driven a truck?
Have you ever lost your phone?

rules.explanation_en: Already (in positives) and just mean recently or before now. Yet is used in negatives and questions, at the end.
rules.explanation_ar: already (في المثبت) و just تعنيان قبل الآن أو منذ قليل. و yet تُستخدم في النفي والأسئلة وتأتي في الآخر.
rules.syntax: have + already/just + p.p. / haven't + p.p. + yet.

rules.explanation_en: Been to means went and came back. Gone to means went and is still there.
rules.explanation_ar: been to تعني ذهب وعاد. و gone to تعني ذهب وما زال هناك.
rules.syntax: have/has been to + place. / have/has gone to + place.

examples.en: He has gone to the shop.
examples.ar: ذهب إلى المحل وما زال هناك.

rules.explanation_en: Use for + a period of time (for five years). Use since + a starting point (since 2020). How long...? asks about the period.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم for + مدة (for five years). ونستخدم since + نقطة بداية (since 2020). و How long...? تسأل عن المدة.
rules.syntax: have/has + p.p. + for + period / since + starting point.

examples.en: I have lived here for five years.
We have known him for ten years.
He has been ill since Monday.
They have been married for two years.
I have had this phone since May.
How long have you lived here?
She has studied English for a year.
I haven't seen him for a week.

rules.explanation_en: Use the present perfect for experiences with no time. Use the past simple when you say when it happened.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع التام للتجارب بدون ذكر وقت. ونستخدم الماضي البسيط عندما نذكر وقت الحدوث.
rules.syntax: Experience: have + p.p. / Time given: past simple.

examples.en: Yes, I flew to Dubai last month.
examples.ar: نعم، سافرت إلى دبي الشهر الماضي.

examples.en: He lost it at the airport.

rules.explanation_en: Ask about a past trip with the past simple: Where did you go? How did you travel? Did you enjoy it?
rules.explanation_ar: نسأل عن رحلة سابقة بالماضي البسيط: Where did you go? و How did you travel? و Did you enjoy it?
rules.syntax: Wh- word + did + subject + base verb?

examples.en: We took a lot of photos.

rules.explanation_en: Use must for strong rules and duties. Must is the same for all subjects and is followed by the base verb.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم must للقواعد والواجبات القوية. وهي نفسها مع كل الفواعل ويتبعها الفعل الأساسي.
rules.syntax: Subject + must + base verb.

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt.
We must stop at the red light.
examples.ar: يجب أن نتوقف عند الإشارة الحمراء.

rules.explanation_en: Mustn't means it is forbidden. Don't have to means it is not necessary, but you can if you want.
rules.explanation_ar: mustn't تعني أن الشيء ممنوع. و don't have to تعني أنه غير ضروري لكن يمكنك فعله إن أردت.
rules.syntax: Subject + mustn't + verb. / Subject + don't/doesn't have to + verb.

examples.en: She doesn't have to work today.
He doesn't have to wear a tie.

rules.explanation_en: Have to means it is necessary because of a rule or situation. Use has to with he, she, it.
rules.explanation_ar: have to تعني أن الشيء ضروري بسبب قاعدة أو ظرف. ونستخدم has to مع he و she و it.
rules.syntax: I/you/we/they + have to + verb. He/she/it + has to + verb.

examples.en: She has to get up early.
We have to wear a uniform.
My father has to drive far.
examples.ar: على أبي أن يقود لمسافة بعيدة.

examples.en: I have to go to the bank.
The doctor has to see him.

rules.explanation_en: Use don't/doesn't have to for the negative. Use Do/Does + subject + have to for questions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم don't/doesn't have to للنفي. ونستخدم Do/Does + الفاعل + have to للسؤال.
rules.syntax: Do/Does + subject + have to + verb?

examples.en: I don't have to work on Friday.
Do you have to work today?
Does he have to wear a suit?
What do I have to do?

rules.explanation_en: Use should to give advice. It is the same for all subjects, followed by the base verb.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم should لإعطاء النصيحة. وهي نفسها مع كل الفواعل ويتبعها الفعل الأساسي.
rules.syntax: Subject + should + base verb.

rules.explanation_en: Use shouldn't for negative advice. Ask for advice with Should I...? or What should I do?
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم shouldn't للنصيحة المنفية. ونطلب النصيحة بـ Should I...? أو What should I do?
rules.syntax: Subject + shouldn't + verb. / Should + subject + verb?

rules.explanation_en: Use have + a / an + illness (I have a headache). Use hurt for pain in a body part (My back hurts).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have + a / an + المرض (I have a headache). ونستخدم hurt للألم في جزء من الجسم (My back hurts).
rules.syntax: I have a + illness. / My + body part + hurts.

rules.explanation_en: Doctors ask questions and give advice with imperatives and should.
rules.explanation_ar: الأطباء يسألون ويعطون النصائح بأفعال الأمر وبـ should.
rules.syntax: Base verb + object. / You should + verb.

examples.en: Take this medicine twice a day.

rules.explanation_en: Use fixed phrases on the phone. Say This is... (not I am...) to say who you are.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم عبارات ثابتة في الهاتف. نقول This is... (وليس I am...) لنعرّف بأنفسنا.
rules.syntax: This is + name. / Can I speak to + name?

examples.en: Can I speak to Sara, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكنني التحدث إلى سارة من فضلك؟

rules.explanation_en: Use polite questions when you cannot hear or understand: Can you repeat that? Can you speak more slowly?
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم أسئلة مهذبة عندما لا نسمع أو لا نفهم: Can you repeat that? و Can you speak more slowly?
rules.syntax: Can you + verb, please?

examples.ar: آسف، هل يمكنك أن تكرر ذلك؟
هل يمكنك تهجئة ذلك من فضلك؟

rules.explanation_en: Start with Dear + name (formal) or Hi + name (informal). End with Kind regards or Best wishes.
rules.explanation_ar: نبدأ بـ Dear + الاسم (رسمي) أو Hi + الاسم (غير رسمي). وننهي بـ Kind regards أو Best wishes.
rules.syntax: Greeting, + message + closing, + name.

examples.en: I am writing to ask about the job.

rules.explanation_en: Use Could you...? and I would like... for polite requests. Say Please find... attached for a file.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم Could you...? و I would like... للطلبات المهذبة. ونقول Please find... attached للملف المرفق.
rules.syntax: Could you + verb? / I would like + noun/to + verb.

examples.en: Could you send me the file?
I would like to book a room.
I am sorry for the delay.
Let me know if you have questions.
I look forward to your reply.

rules.explanation_en: Could you...? is more polite than Can you...?. Use please and thank you.
rules.explanation_ar: Could you...? أكثر أدبًا من Can you...?. ونستخدم please و thank you.
rules.syntax: Could/Can + you + base verb + (please)?

examples.en: Could you show me the way?
Can you lend me a pen?
Can you give me a hand?
Could you tell me the time?

rules.rule: Offering help and Would you mind...?
rules.explanation_en: Offer help with Can I...? or Shall I...?. Use Would you mind + verb-ing? for a very polite request. No, not at all means OK.
rules.explanation_ar: نعرض المساعدة بـ Can I...? أو Shall I...?. ونستخدم Would you mind + فعل ing؟ لطلب مهذب جدًا. و No, not at all تعني موافق.
rules.syntax: Would you mind + verb-ing? / Shall I + verb?

examples.en: Would you mind closing the door?
Do you mind if I sit here?

rules.explanation_en: Review the A2 patterns: past simple, present perfect, future forms, comparatives, modals and polite requests.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة أنماط A2: الماضي البسيط والمضارع التام وصيغ المستقبل والمقارنة والأفعال الناقصة والطلبات المهذبة.
rules.syntax: Choose the pattern that matches the meaning.

examples.en: I went to Cairo last year.
She has lived here for ten years.
Have you ever been to Turkey?
He is going to travel tomorrow.

rules.explanation_en: Past simple = finished time. Present perfect = connection to now. Present continuous = now or arrangement. Going to / will = future.
rules.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط = زمن منتهٍ. المضارع التام = ارتباط بالحاضر. المضارع المستمر = الآن أو ترتيب. going to / will = المستقبل.
rules.syntax: Match the tense to the time word: in 2015 / since 2018 / now / next year.

examples.en: I have lived in Riyadh since 2018.
I'm living with my uncle this month.
I'm going to move next year.

final_test.question: This is the ___ film I have seen.
It's cold. I ___ close the window.
You have a fever. You ___ see a doctor.
final_test.question_ar: لديك حمى. ينبغي أن ترى طبيبًا.

rules.explanation_en: Use was/were + verb-ing for an action in progress at a past moment. Use was with I/he/she/it and were with you/we/they.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم was/were + فعل ing لحدث كان مستمرًا في لحظة في الماضي. was مع I/he/she/it و were مع you/we/they.
rules.syntax: Subject + was/were + verb-ing.

examples.en: I was reading a book at nine.
We were waiting for the bus.
I was working in Riyadh last year.
examples.ar: كنت أعمل في الرياض العام الماضي.

examples.en: You were talking on the phone.

rules.explanation_en: Use wasn't/weren't + verb-ing for the negative. For questions put Was/Were before the subject.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم wasn't/weren't + فعل ing للنفي. وللسؤال نضع Was/Were قبل الفاعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + wasn't/weren't + verb-ing. / Was/Were + subject + verb-ing?

examples.en: Yes, I was. No, they weren't.

rules.explanation_en: Use the past continuous for the longer action in progress and the past simple for the shorter action that interrupts it. While goes with the continuous. When often goes with the simple.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي المستمر للحدث الأطول الجاري، والماضي البسيط للحدث القصير الذي يقاطعه. while مع المستمر و when غالبًا مع البسيط.
rules.syntax: Past continuous + when + past simple. / While + past continuous, past simple.

examples.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.ar: كنت أمشي إلى المنزل عندما بدأت تمطر.

examples.en: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
He fell while he was running.
We were watching TV when the lights went out.
examples.ar: كنا نشاهد التلفاز عندما انقطع الضوء.

examples.en: When I arrived, they were eating.
She was sleeping when I called.
While I was studying, my brother was playing.
examples.ar: بينما كنت أذاكر كان أخي يلعب.

examples.en: The bus came while we were talking.
I saw an accident while I was driving.
They were leaving when the guests arrived.

rules.explanation_en: Use used to + base verb for past habits and states that are not true now. Questions and negatives use use to.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم used to + الفعل الأساسي للعادات والحالات في الماضي التي لم تعد صحيحة الآن. وفي النفي والسؤال نستخدم use to.
rules.syntax: Subject + used to + base verb. / Did + subject + use to + verb?

examples.en: I used to play football every day.
examples.ar: كنت ألعب كرة القدم كل يوم.

examples.en: She used to live in Cairo.
We used to visit our grandmother on Fridays.
He didn't use to like fish.
Did you use to walk to school?
There used to be a park here.
They used to have a small shop.
I didn't use to wake up early.

rules.explanation_en: Use have/has been + verb-ing for an action that started in the past and is still going on, or has just stopped with a visible result.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/has been + فعل ing لحدث بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا، أو توقف للتو وله أثر واضح.
rules.syntax: Subject + have/has been + verb-ing.

examples.en: I have been waiting for an hour.
She has been studying all day.
We have been living here since 2020.
It has been raining since morning.
They have been playing for two hours.
I've been learning English for a year.
She's been talking on the phone.

rules.rule: Questions and comparison with present perfect
rules.explanation_en: Use How long...? with the continuous. The continuous focuses on the activity. The simple focuses on the result or number.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم How long...? مع المستمر. المستمر يركز على النشاط، والبسيط يركز على النتيجة أو العدد.
rules.syntax: How long + have/has + subject + been + verb-ing?

examples.en: How long have you been waiting?
I've been reading this book for a week.
She has been painting the room.
Why are your hands dirty? I've been cooking.

rules.explanation_en: Use had + past participle for an action that happened before another past action.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم had + التصريف الثالث لحدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي.
rules.syntax: Subject + had + past participle.

examples.en: When I arrived, the film had started.
examples.ar: عندما وصلت كان الفيلم قد بدأ.

examples.en: She had left before I called.
examples.ar: كانت قد غادرت قبل أن أتصل.

examples.en: I had never seen the sea before.
examples.ar: لم أكن قد رأيت البحر من قبل.

examples.en: We had finished when he came.
The shop had closed by six.
examples.ar: كان المحل قد أغلق بحلول السادسة.

examples.en: I realised I had forgotten my phone.

examples.ar: هل كنت قد قابلته من قبل؟

examples.en: She hadn't studied, so she failed.

rules.explanation_en: Use linking words to tell a story in order: suddenly, meanwhile, as soon as, after a while, in the end.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم أدوات الربط لسرد قصة بترتيب: suddenly و meanwhile و as soon as و after a while و in the end.
rules.syntax: Linking word, + clause.

examples.ar: في هذه الأثناء كنت أنتظر في الخارج.

examples.en: As soon as I saw him, I smiled.
After a while, he came back.
In the end, we found the key.
Before he left, he said goodbye.

rules.explanation_en: Use going to for plans and for predictions with evidence. Use will for sudden decisions, offers and opinions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم going to للخطط وللتنبؤات المبنية على دليل. ونستخدم will للقرارات المفاجئة والعروض والآراء.
rules.syntax: going to = plan / evidence. will = sudden decision / opinion.

examples.en: I'm going to buy a car; I've saved the money.
It's cloudy. It's going to rain.
The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.
I think she'll pass the exam.
We're going to move next month.
He's going to be a doctor.
They're going to build a bridge.
Perhaps it will be sunny tomorrow.

rules.explanation_en: Use the present continuous for fixed arrangements. Use the present simple for timetables and schedules.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر للترتيبات المؤكدة، والمضارع البسيط للجداول والمواعيد الثابتة.
rules.syntax: am/is/are + verb-ing + time. / present simple + time (timetable).

examples.en: I'm meeting my manager at ten.
We're flying to Jeddah on Friday.
The shop opens at nine tomorrow.
What time does the flight arrive?
She's starting a new job on Monday.
The bus doesn't leave until ten.

rules.explanation_en: Use the first conditional for real or possible future situations. Use the present simple in the if-clause and will in the result clause.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الشرط الأول لمواقف مستقبلية حقيقية أو ممكنة. المضارع البسيط في جملة if و will في جملة النتيجة.
rules.syntax: If + present simple, will + base verb.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay home.
If you study, you will pass.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
She will be late if she misses the bus.
If we hurry, we'll catch the train.
If you don't eat, you'll be hungry.
They'll win if they play well.
If I have time, I'll help you.
If the weather is good, we'll go out.

rules.rule: Unless, when, as soon as and might
rules.explanation_en: Unless means if not. After when, as soon as, before and until, use the present simple for the future. Might makes the result less certain.
rules.explanation_ar: unless تعني if not. وبعد when و as soon as و before و until نستخدم المضارع البسيط للمستقبل. و might تجعل النتيجة أقل يقينًا.
rules.syntax: Unless + present, will. / When/As soon as + present, will.

examples.en: I won't go unless you come.
Unless it rains, we'll play outside.
examples.ar: ما لم تمطر سنلعب في الخارج.

examples.en: I'll call you when I arrive.
As soon as I finish, I'll call you.
If it's cold, I might wear a coat.
examples.ar: إذا كان الجو باردًا فقد أرتدي معطفًا.

examples.en: She might come if she's free.
If you need help, just ask.
examples.ar: إذا احتجت إلى مساعدة فاسأل فقط.

examples.en: What will you do if you fail?

rules.explanation_en: May, might and could show that something is possible but not certain. They are followed by the base verb.
rules.explanation_ar: may و might و could تدل على أن الشيء ممكن لكنه غير مؤكد. ويتبعها الفعل الأساسي.
rules.syntax: Subject + may/might/could + base verb.

examples.en: We might go to the beach.

rules.explanation_en: Probably and definitely go after will but before won't. Perhaps and maybe go at the start of the sentence.
rules.explanation_ar: probably و definitely تأتيان بعد will وقبل won't. و perhaps و maybe تأتيان في بداية الجملة.
rules.syntax: will + probably/definitely. / probably/definitely + won't.

rules.explanation_en: Use could for general ability in the past. Use was/were able to for one successful result. Use will be able to for the future.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم could للقدرة العامة في الماضي، و was/were able to لنجاح في حدث واحد، و will be able to للمستقبل.
rules.syntax: could + verb. / was/were/will be able to + verb.

examples.en: I could swim when I was five.
examples.ar: كنت أستطيع السباحة عندما كنت في الخامسة.

examples.en: I was able to finish the work yesterday.
Will you be able to help me?
I'm able to speak three languages.
She hasn't been able to sleep.
I'd like to be able to drive.
examples.ar: أود أن أكون قادرًا على القيادة.

rules.explanation_en: Use Can I...?, Could I...? and May I...? to ask permission. Use be allowed to to talk about rules.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم Can I...? و Could I...? و May I...? لطلب الإذن. ونستخدم be allowed to للحديث عن القواعد.
rules.syntax: Can/Could/May + I + verb? / be allowed to + verb.

examples.en: You are allowed to wait here.
We aren't allowed to use phones.
Are we allowed to take photos?
Is it OK if I open the window?
examples.ar: هل لا بأس إذا فتحت النافذة؟

rules.explanation_en: Use work as + job, work for + company, work in + place. Use a/an before a job.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم work as + الوظيفة و work for + الشركة و work in + المكان. ونستخدم a/an قبل الوظيفة.
rules.syntax: Subject + work(s) as/for/in + noun.

examples.en: They work for a big company.

rules.explanation_en: Use be good at + noun/-ing, be responsible for, be interested in, need to and have to to describe skills and duties.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم be good at + اسم/ing و be responsible for و be interested in و need to و have to لوصف المهارات والواجبات.
rules.syntax: be good/bad at + noun/verb-ing. / be responsible for + noun.

examples.en: A driver has to have a licence.
examples.ar: على السائق أن يكون لديه رخصة.

examples.en: She is good at solving problems.
He is responsible for the team.
I am interested in this job.
You need to be on time.
We are looking for a new worker.
I'm able to work in a team.

rules.explanation_en: Interviewers ask about your background, skills and plans. Many questions begin with Tell me, Why, What or Where.
rules.explanation_ar: يسأل القائمون على المقابلة عن خلفيتك ومهاراتك وخططك. وكثير من الأسئلة تبدأ بـ Tell me أو Why أو What أو Where.
rules.syntax: Wh- word + do/did/can + you + verb?

examples.en: Why do you want this job?

examples.ar: ما هي أكبر نقطة ضعف لديك؟

examples.en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
examples.ar: أين ترى نفسك بعد خمس سنوات؟

examples.en: Why did you leave your last job?
Can you work in a team?
How much experience do you have?

rules.explanation_en: Use the present perfect for experience up to now. Use the past simple for finished jobs. Be honest, clear and polite.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع التام للخبرة حتى الآن، والماضي البسيط للوظائف المنتهية. كن صادقًا وواضحًا ومهذبًا.
rules.syntax: I have + p.p. (experience). / I + past simple (finished job).

examples.en: I have worked as a driver for five years.
I worked at a factory in Cairo.
I am good at working under pressure.
examples.ar: أنا جيد في العمل تحت الضغط.

examples.en: I have learned a lot from my job.
I left because I wanted a new challenge.
I would like to learn new skills.
I look forward to hearing from you.

rules.explanation_en: Use full forms, polite phrases and a formal ending. Use Yours faithfully after Dear Sir or Madam.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الصيغ الكاملة وعبارات مهذبة ونهاية رسمية. ونستخدم Yours faithfully بعد Dear Sir or Madam.
rules.syntax: Dear + title + name, + I am writing to + verb... + Yours sincerely.

examples.en: I am writing to apply for the position.
I would be grateful if you could help.
I look forward to hearing from you.
I am writing to complain about the service.
Could you please confirm the date?
examples.ar: هل يمكنكم تأكيد التاريخ من فضلكم؟

examples.en: Thank you for your prompt reply.
We regret to inform you that...

rules.explanation_en: Use contractions, short phrases and friendly endings with friends and family.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الاختصارات وعبارات قصيرة ونهايات ودية مع الأصدقاء والعائلة.
rules.syntax: Hi + name, + short message + See you / Take care.

examples.ar: آسف لأنني لم أكتب قبل ذلك.

examples.en: Can you send me the photos?
examples.ar: هل يمكنك أن ترسل لي الصور؟

examples.en: Let me know what you think.
I can't wait to see you!

rules.explanation_en: Some verbs are followed by the -ing form: enjoy, suggest, finish, avoid, mind, keep. Prepositions are also followed by -ing.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال يتبعها فعل ing: enjoy و suggest و finish و avoid و mind و keep. وحروف الجر كذلك يتبعها ing.
rules.syntax: enjoy/suggest/finish/avoid/mind/keep + verb-ing. / preposition + verb-ing.

examples.en: She suggested going to the library.

rules.explanation_en: Some verbs are followed by to + base verb: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn, forget. Use to + verb to say why you do something.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال يتبعها to + الفعل الأساسي: want و decide و hope و need و promise و learn و forget. ونستخدم to + فعل لبيان سبب فعل شيء.
rules.syntax: want/decide/hope/need/promise/learn + to + base verb.

examples.en: I want to pass the exam.
He hopes to get a good job.
examples.ar: يأمل في الحصول على وظيفة جيدة.

examples.en: He forgot to bring his book.

rules.explanation_en: Use the passive when the action is more important than who does it. Form: am/is/are + past participle.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم المبني للمجهول عندما يكون الحدث أهم من الفاعل. الصيغة: am/is/are + التصريف الثالث.
rules.syntax: Subject + am/is/are + past participle.

examples.en: The shop is opened at nine.
Cars are made in this factory.
The rooms are cleaned every day.
Is the bank closed on Friday?
Tea is drunk all over the world.
examples.ar: يُشرب الشاي في كل أنحاء العالم.

rules.explanation_en: Form: was/were + past participle. Use by + agent only when it is important to say who did it.
rules.explanation_ar: الصيغة: was/were + التصريف الثالث. نستخدم by + الفاعل فقط عندما يكون مهمًا ذكر من فعل ذلك.
rules.syntax: Subject + was/were + past participle (+ by + agent).

examples.en: The car was stolen last night.
Were you invited to the party?
The book was written by Naguib Mahfouz.

rules.explanation_en: Form: modal + be + past participle. Use with can, must, should, will and might.
rules.explanation_ar: الصيغة: modal + be + التصريف الثالث. مع can و must و should و will و might.
rules.syntax: Subject + modal + be + past participle.

examples.en: The work must be finished today.
The door can be opened with a key.
The report will be sent tomorrow.
The meeting will be held on Monday.
The car has to be repaired.
This medicine should be taken twice a day.
examples.ar: ينبغي تناول هذا الدواء مرتين يوميًا.

rules.rule: Present perfect passive and by + agent
rules.explanation_en: Form: have/has been + past participle. Use by to say who did the action.
rules.explanation_ar: الصيغة: have/has been + التصريف الثالث. نستخدم by لنذكر من قام بالفعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + have/has been + past participle (+ by + agent).

examples.en: The project has been finished by the team.
The picture was painted by Picasso.
The film was directed by a famous man.
The window was broken by the boys.
The house has not been sold yet.

rules.explanation_en: In reported speech the tense usually goes one step back: present -> past, past -> past perfect, will -> would, can -> could. Use say (no object) or tell + person.
rules.explanation_ar: في الكلام المنقول يرجع الزمن خطوة للوراء عادةً: المضارع -> ماضٍ، الماضي -> ماضٍ تام، will -> would، can -> could. نستخدم say بدون مفعول أو tell + شخص.
rules.syntax: Subject + said (that) + clause with backshift. / told + person + clause.

examples.en: 'I am tired.' -> He said he was tired.
'I work here.' -> She said she worked here.
'We are leaving.' -> They said they were leaving.
'I have finished.' -> He said he had finished.
'I went home.' -> She said she had gone home.
'I will call you.' -> He said he would call me.
'I can swim.' -> She said she could swim.
'I don't know.' -> He said he didn't know.
'We are studying.' -> They told me they were studying.
'I like tea.' -> She told me she liked tea.

rules.rule: Changes of time and place words
rules.explanation_en: Time and place words also change when the time or place of the report is different: now -> then, today -> that day, tomorrow -> the next day, yesterday -> the day before, here -> there, this -> that.
rules.explanation_ar: كلمات الزمان والمكان تتغير أيضًا: now -> then و today -> that day و tomorrow -> the next day و yesterday -> the day before و here -> there و this -> that.
rules.syntax: now/then, tomorrow/the next day, yesterday/the day before, here/there.

examples.en: 'I'm here now.' -> She said she was there then.
'I'll come tomorrow.' -> He said he would come the next day.
examples.ar: قال إنه سيأتي في اليوم التالي.

examples.en: 'I saw her yesterday.' -> He said he had seen her the day before.
examples.ar: قال إنه رآها في اليوم السابق.

examples.en: 'We arrived last week.' -> They said they had arrived the week before.
'I'm leaving today.' -> She said she was leaving that day.
'This is my book.' -> He said that was his book.
'I live here.' -> She said she lived there.
'I'll see you next week.' -> He said he would see me the following week.
'I'm busy now.' -> He said he was busy then.
'My car is here.' -> She said her car was there.

rules.explanation_en: In reported questions use statement word order (no do/does and no question mark). Use if or whether for yes/no questions.
rules.explanation_ar: في الأسئلة المنقولة نستخدم ترتيب الجملة الخبرية (بدون do/does وبدون علامة استفهام). ونستخدم if أو whether لأسئلة نعم/لا.
rules.syntax: asked + (wh- word / if) + subject + verb (backshifted).

examples.en: 'Where do you live?' -> He asked where I lived.
'Are you tired?' -> She asked if I was tired.
'What is your name?' -> He asked what my name was.
'Do you like tea?' -> She asked whether I liked tea.
'When did you arrive?' -> He asked when I had arrived.
'Can you swim?' -> She asked if I could swim.
'Why are you late?' -> He asked why I was late.
'Have you eaten?' -> She asked if I had eaten.
'Where is the bank?' -> I asked where the bank was.
'Will you come?' -> He asked if I would come.

rules.explanation_en: Use told/asked + person + (not) to + base verb for commands and requests.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم told/asked + شخص + (not) to + فعل أساسي للأوامر والطلبات.
rules.syntax: told/asked + person + (not) to + base verb.

examples.en: 'Open the door.' -> He told me to open the door.
'Please sit down.' -> She asked me to sit down.
'Don't be late.' -> He told me not to be late.
'Close the window, please.' -> She asked him to close the window.
'Don't touch it.' -> She told the child not to touch it.
'Wait here.' -> He told us to wait there.
'Could you help me?' -> She asked me to help her.
'Don't smoke.' -> The doctor told him not to smoke.
'Call me later.' -> He asked me to call him later.
'Be quiet.' -> The teacher told them to be quiet.

rules.explanation_en: Use the second conditional for unreal or unlikely situations in the present or future. If + past simple, would + base verb. With be, we often use were for all subjects.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الشرط الثاني للمواقف غير الواقعية أو غير المحتملة في الحاضر أو المستقبل. If + ماضٍ بسيط، would + فعل أساسي. ومع be نستخدم were غالبًا مع كل الفواعل.
rules.syntax: If + past simple, would + base verb.

examples.en: If I had money, I would buy a car.
examples.ar: لو كان لدي مال لاشتريت سيارة.

examples.en: If she knew, she would tell us.
If we lived near the sea, we would swim every day.
examples.ar: لو سكنا قرب البحر لسبحنا كل يوم.

examples.en: If I were rich, I would travel.
If he studied more, he would pass.
If it was sunny, we would go out.
They would help if they had time.
I would call him if I knew his number.
examples.ar: كنت سأتصل به لو عرفت رقمه.

examples.en: If she had a car, she wouldn't take the bus.
examples.ar: لو كان لديها سيارة لما ركبت الحافلة.

examples.en: We wouldn't be late if we left now.

rules.rule: Questions and If I were you
rules.explanation_en: Ask hypothetical questions with What would you do if...? Use If I were you to give advice.
rules.explanation_ar: نسأل أسئلة افتراضية بـ What would you do if...? ونستخدم If I were you لإعطاء النصيحة.
rules.syntax: What would + subject + do + if + past simple? / If I were you, I would + verb.

examples.en: What would you do if you won a million?
Where would you live if you could choose?
Would you help me if I asked?
If I were you, I would stay.
If I were you, I wouldn't go.
What would you say if you saw him?
If you could fly, where would you go?
Would she come if we invited her?
I'd be happy if you came.
If I were you, I'd ask the teacher.

rules.explanation_en: Use wish + past simple to talk about things you want to be different in the present. Use were for all subjects with be.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم wish + ماضٍ بسيط للحديث عن أشياء نتمنى أن تكون مختلفة في الحاضر. ونستخدم were مع كل الفواعل مع be.
rules.syntax: Subject + wish + subject + past simple.

examples.en: I wish I had a car.
She wishes she lived in Paris.
examples.ar: تتمنى لو كانت تعيش في باريس.

examples.en: We wish we had more time.
examples.ar: نتمنى لو كان لدينا وقت أكثر.

examples.en: He wishes he knew the answer.
They wish they were on holiday.
I wish it wasn't so cold.
examples.ar: أتمنى لو لم يكن الجو باردًا هكذا.

examples.en: She wishes she didn't have to work.
examples.ar: تتمنى لو لم يكن عليها أن تعمل.

examples.en: I wish I spoke English well.
examples.ar: أتمنى لو كنت أتحدث الإنجليزية جيدًا.

rules.explanation_en: Use wish + would to complain about something that annoys you or to ask for a change. If only is a stronger form of wish.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم wish + would للشكوى من شيء مزعج أو لطلب تغيير. و if only صيغة أقوى من wish.
rules.syntax: wish + subject + would + verb. / If only + past simple.

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.
I wish he would call me.
She wishes the bus would come.
If only I had more money!
I wish they would be quiet.

rules.explanation_en: Use I think, I believe, in my opinion, personally and from my point of view to give your opinion.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم I think و I believe و in my opinion و personally و from my point of view لإبداء الرأي.
rules.syntax: I think/believe (that) + clause. / In my opinion, + clause.

examples.en: I think it is a good idea.
In my opinion, he is right.
As far as I'm concerned, it's too expensive.
I feel that it is unfair.
It seems to me that he is tired.
I don't think it's a good idea.
From my point of view, it's difficult.
I'm sure you will like it.

rules.explanation_en: Agree directly (I agree) or politely disagree (I see what you mean, but...). Ask for opinions with What do you think?
rules.explanation_ar: نوافق مباشرة (I agree) أو نخالف بأدب (I see what you mean, but...). ونسأل عن الرأي بـ What do you think?
rules.syntax: I (don't) agree with + person. / I see what you mean, but...

examples.en: That's true, but it is expensive.
I see what you mean, but I'm not sure.
examples.ar: أفهم ما تقصد لكنني لست متأكدًا.

rules.explanation_en: Use If I were you, you'd better (= you had better), you ought to and I'd advise you to. 'd better is followed by the base verb.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم If I were you و you'd better (= you had better) و you ought to و I'd advise you to. و 'd better يتبعها الفعل الأساسي.
rules.syntax: You'd better + base verb. / You ought to + base verb.

examples.en: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
examples.ar: لو كنت مكانك لذهبت إلى الطبيب.

examples.en: You had better not be late.
It's a good idea to save money.
If I were you, I wouldn't buy it.

rules.explanation_en: Suggest and recommend are followed by -ing or by a clause with should / the base verb. They are not followed by to + verb.
rules.explanation_ar: suggest و recommend يتبعهما فعل ing أو جملة. ولا يتبعهما to + فعل.
rules.syntax: suggest/recommend + verb-ing / noun / that + clause.

examples.en: She suggested going to the cinema.
I suggest that you call him.
Can you recommend a good hotel?
examples.ar: هل يمكنك أن توصي بفندق جيد؟

rules.explanation_en: Use who for people, which for things, and that for both. The relative clause gives essential information and has no commas.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم who للأشخاص و which للأشياء و that للنوعين. وجملة الصلة تعطي معلومة أساسية وبدون فواصل.
rules.syntax: noun + who/which/that + verb.

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The book which I bought is good.
The car that he drives is old.
I know a woman who speaks five languages.
This is the shop that sells shoes.
examples.ar: هذا هو المحل الذي يبيع الأحذية.

examples.en: The people who work here are kind.
The phone which is on the table is mine.
A teacher is a person who teaches.
The film that we watched was long.
Where is the girl who called you?

rules.explanation_en: Use whose for possession, where for places and when for times.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم whose للملكية و where للأماكن و when للأزمنة.
rules.syntax: noun + whose + noun + verb. / place + where + clause. / time + when + clause.

examples.en: The man whose car was stolen called the police.
examples.ar: الرجل الذي سُرقت سيارته اتصل بالشرطة.

examples.en: I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
This is the town where I was born.
examples.ar: هذه هي البلدة التي وُلدت فيها.

examples.en: The restaurant where we ate was great.
examples.ar: المطعم الذي أكلنا فيه كان رائعًا.

examples.en: I remember the day when we met.
Summer is the time when it is hot.
examples.ar: الصيف هو الوقت الذي يكون فيه الجو حارًا.

examples.en: That is the woman whose son is a doctor.
examples.ar: تلك هي المرأة التي ابنها طبيب.

examples.en: This is the school where I studied.
examples.ar: هذه هي المدرسة التي درست فيها.

examples.en: Do you know the place where he works?
examples.ar: هل تعرف المكان الذي يعمل فيه؟

examples.en: It was the year when I got married.

lessons.title: Non-defining Clauses and Omission
lessons.title_ar: الجمل غير المحددة وحذف الاسم الموصول

rules.explanation_en: A non-defining clause adds extra information and uses commas. Use who or which (not that). The sentence still makes sense without it.
rules.explanation_ar: الجملة غير المحددة تضيف معلومة إضافية وتُكتب بين فواصل. نستخدم who أو which (وليس that). وتبقى الجملة مفهومة بدونها.
rules.syntax: noun, + who/which + clause, + rest.

examples.en: My brother, who lives in Dubai, is a doctor.
examples.ar: أخي الذي يعيش في دبي طبيب.

examples.en: Cairo, which is a big city, is hot.
My car, which is red, is new.
Mr. Ali, who is my teacher, is kind.
The Nile, which is very long, flows north.
examples.ar: النيل، وهو طويل جدًا، يجري شمالًا.

examples.en: My mother, who is sixty, cooks well.
examples.ar: أمي، وهي في الستين، تطبخ جيدًا.

examples.en: Riyadh, where I live, is hot.
This book, which I bought yesterday, is great.
examples.ar: هذا الكتاب الذي اشتريته أمس رائع.

examples.en: Sara, whose brother is a pilot, lives here.
examples.ar: سارة، التي أخوها طيار، تعيش هنا.

examples.en: We stayed at the hotel, which was very cheap.
examples.ar: أقمنا في الفندق، وكان رخيصًا جدًا.

rules.explanation_en: You can leave out who, which or that when it is the object of the clause (when another subject follows it).
rules.explanation_ar: يمكن حذف who أو which أو that عندما تكون مفعولًا به في الجملة (أي عندما يأتي بعدها فاعل آخر).
rules.syntax: noun + subject + verb (no relative pronoun).

examples.en: The book I read was good.
The man I met is a doctor.
The film we saw was long.
The food she cooked was delicious.
Is this the bag you lost?
examples.ar: هل هذه هي الحقيبة التي أضعتها؟

examples.en: The girl he loves is kind.
The shoes I bought are comfortable.
That's the man I told you about.
examples.ar: ذلك هو الرجل الذي حدثتك عنه.

examples.en: The car he drives is fast.

rules.explanation_en: Although / even though + clause. Despite / in spite of + noun or -ing. However starts a new sentence and has a comma after it.
rules.explanation_ar: although / even though + جملة. و despite / in spite of + اسم أو ing. و however تبدأ جملة جديدة وبعدها فاصلة.
rules.syntax: Although + clause. / Despite + noun/-ing. / However, + clause.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
Even though he was tired, he worked.
examples.ar: رغم أنه كان متعبًا فقد عمل.

examples.en: She is rich, but she isn't happy.
Despite the rain, we had fun.
In spite of being ill, he came.
The flat is small. However, it is cheap.
examples.ar: الشقة صغيرة. ومع ذلك فهي رخيصة.

examples.en: It is cheaper. On the other hand, it is slower.
examples.ar: هو أرخص. من ناحية أخرى هو أبطأ.

examples.en: He is clever, yet he is lazy.

rules.rule: Purpose and result: to, so that, so, therefore
rules.explanation_en: Use to / in order to + verb for purpose. Use so that + clause for purpose. Use so and therefore for result.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم to / in order to + فعل للغرض. ونستخدم so that + جملة للغرض. ونستخدم so و therefore للنتيجة.
rules.syntax: to + verb. / so that + clause. / , so + clause. / Therefore, + clause.

examples.en: I study to get a good job.
She saved money in order to buy a car.
We left early so that we wouldn't be late.
I went to the shop to buy bread.
It was raining, so we stayed home.
He was ill. Therefore, he didn't come.
She works hard, so she earns a lot.
The road was closed. As a result, we were late.
I'm saving money so that I can travel.
He wore a coat because it was cold.
examples.ar: ارتدى معطفًا لأن الجو كان باردًا.

rules.explanation_en: Use firstly, secondly, in addition, moreover, for example and in conclusion to organise ideas clearly.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم firstly و secondly و in addition و moreover و for example و in conclusion لتنظيم الأفكار بوضوح.
rules.syntax: Firstly, ... Secondly, ... In addition, ... In conclusion, ...

examples.en: First of all, I want to talk about the cost.
On the one hand, it is easy.
In conclusion, I think it is a good idea.
examples.ar: في الختام أعتقد أنها فكرة جيدة.

examples.en: To sum up, there are many advantages.
Finally, it is important to try.

rules.explanation_en: Review the main B1 patterns: perfect and continuous tenses, conditionals, passive, reported speech, relative clauses and connectors.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة أهم أنماط B1: الأزمنة التامة والمستمرة والشرط والمبني للمجهول والكلام المنقول وجمل الصلة وأدوات الربط.
rules.syntax: Choose the structure that matches the meaning.

examples.en: I have been working here since 2020.
When I arrived, she had left.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
If I were you, I'd go.
The report was written by Sara.
The man who called is my boss.
Although it was late, we continued.
examples.ar: رغم أن الوقت كان متأخرًا واصلنا.

examples.en: I wish I had more time.
examples.ar: أتمنى لو كان لدي وقت أكثر.

examples.en: She used to live in Cairo.

final_test.question: When we arrived, the film ___.
final_test.question_ar: عندما وصلنا كان الفيلم قد بدأ.

final_test.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay home.
final_test.question_ar: إذا أمطرت غدًا سنبقى في المنزل.

final_test.question: If I ___ rich, I would travel.
The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
___ it was raining, we went out.

rules.explanation_en: Use will be + verb-ing for an action that will be in progress at a certain time in the future, or for polite questions about plans.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم will be + فعل ing لحدث سيكون جاريًا في وقت معين في المستقبل، أو للأسئلة المهذبة عن الخطط.
rules.syntax: Subject + will be + verb-ing.

examples.en: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Dubai.
examples.ar: في مثل هذا الوقت غدًا سأكون مسافرًا إلى دبي.

examples.en: At eight o'clock she will be sleeping.
Don't call at noon; we'll be having lunch.
examples.ar: لا تتصل ظهرًا؛ سنكون نتناول الغداء.

examples.en: Next week I'll be working in Riyadh.
examples.ar: الأسبوع القادم سأكون أعمل في الرياض.

examples.en: They will be waiting for us at the station.
Will you be using the car tonight?
In ten years we'll be living abroad.
examples.ar: بعد عشر سنوات سنكون نعيش في الخارج.

examples.en: He won't be coming to the party.
What will you be doing this time next year?
examples.ar: ماذا ستكون تفعل في مثل هذا الوقت من العام القادم؟

rules.explanation_en: Use will have + past participle for an action that will be finished before a certain time in the future. It is often used with by + time.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم will have + التصريف الثالث لحدث سينتهي قبل وقت معين في المستقبل. وغالبًا مع by + وقت.
rules.syntax: Subject + will have + past participle (+ by + time).

examples.en: By Friday I will have finished the report.
examples.ar: بحلول الجمعة سأكون قد أنهيت التقرير.

examples.en: We will have lived here for ten years in May.
examples.ar: في مايو سنكون قد أقمنا هنا عشر سنوات.

examples.en: By the time you arrive, they will have left.
Will you have finished by six?
examples.ar: هل ستكون قد أنهيت بحلول السادسة؟

examples.en: He won't have arrived by noon.
examples.ar: لن يكون قد وصل بحلول الظهر.

examples.en: By next month I will have saved enough.
examples.ar: بحلول الشهر القادم سأكون قد وفرت ما يكفي.

examples.en: They will have built the bridge by 2028.
By this evening the snow will have melted.
examples.ar: بحلول المساء سيكون الثلج قد ذاب.

examples.en: She will have written ten emails by lunch.
examples.ar: ستكون قد كتبت عشر رسائل بحلول الغداء.

rules.rule: Past perfect continuous: form and use
rules.explanation_en: Use had been + verb-ing for an action that was in progress up to a past moment, often to explain a past situation or result.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم had been + فعل ing لحدث كان مستمرًا حتى لحظة في الماضي، وغالبًا لتفسير موقف أو نتيجة في الماضي.
rules.syntax: Subject + had been + verb-ing.

examples.en: I had been waiting for an hour when she arrived.
