examples.ar: كنت أنتظر منذ ساعة عندما وصلت.

examples.en: She had been crying, so her eyes were red.
examples.ar: كانت تبكي لذلك كانت عيناها حمراوين.

examples.en: We had been walking for hours before we found the hotel.
examples.ar: كنا نمشي لساعات قبل أن نجد الفندق.

examples.en: He had been working all night, so he was exhausted.
examples.ar: كان يعمل طوال الليل فكان منهكًا.

examples.en: It had been raining, so the road was wet.
How long had you been studying before the exam?
examples.ar: منذ متى كنت تذاكر قبل الامتحان؟

examples.en: They had been living there for ten years.
examples.ar: كانوا يعيشون هناك منذ عشر سنوات.

examples.en: I hadn't been feeling well, so I stayed home.
examples.ar: لم أكن أشعر بالراحة فبقيت في المنزل.

examples.en: She had been trying to call him all day.
examples.ar: كانت تحاول الاتصال به طوال اليوم.

rules.explanation_en: Use the simple form for a completed action or a number. Use the continuous form for the duration or an activity in progress.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الصيغة البسيطة لحدث مكتمل أو عدد. ونستخدم المستمرة للمدة أو لنشاط كان جاريًا.
rules.syntax: had + p.p. (completed) / had been + verb-ing (in progress).

examples.en: She had written three letters when I arrived.
examples.ar: كانت قد كتبت ثلاث رسائل عندما وصلت.

examples.en: She had been writing letters when I arrived.
I had painted the room by noon.
examples.ar: كنت قد دهنت الغرفة بحلول الظهر.

examples.en: I had been painting all morning.
He had read the book before the film.
examples.ar: كان قد قرأ الكتاب قبل الفيلم.

examples.en: He had been reading all night.
We had been doing homework for hours.
They had known each other for years.
Had she ever been to Rome before?
examples.ar: هل كانت قد زارت روما من قبل؟

rules.explanation_en: In stories use the past simple for main events, the past continuous for background, and the past perfect for earlier events.
rules.explanation_ar: في القصص نستخدم الماضي البسيط للأحداث الرئيسية والماضي المستمر للخلفية والماضي التام للأحداث الأسبق.
rules.syntax: past simple (events) + past continuous (background) + past perfect (earlier).

examples.en: It was a cold night. The wind was blowing and snow was falling.
examples.ar: كانت ليلة باردة. كانت الرياح تهب والثلج يتساقط.

examples.en: I walked into the room and saw that someone had opened the window.
examples.ar: دخلت الغرفة ورأيت أن أحدًا قد فتح النافذة.

examples.en: While she was walking home, she realised she had left her bag.
examples.ar: بينما كانت تمشي إلى المنزل أدركت أنها نسيت حقيبتها.

examples.en: He opened the letter that had arrived that morning.
examples.ar: فتح الرسالة التي وصلت ذلك الصباح.

examples.en: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
examples.ar: كنا نتناول العشاء عندما انطفأت الأنوار.

examples.en: She had never seen the sea before she moved to Alexandria.
examples.ar: لم تكن قد رأت البحر قبل أن تنتقل إلى الإسكندرية.

examples.en: They were laughing when the teacher came in.
By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.
examples.ar: بحلول وصول الشرطة كان اللص قد هرب.

examples.en: I was tired because I had been working all day.
examples.ar: كنت متعبًا لأنني كنت أعمل طوال اليوم.

examples.en: He started the car and drove away.

rules.explanation_en: Use as soon as, the moment, once, by the time and after to link events. Inversion with no sooner...than and hardly...when is formal.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم as soon as و the moment و once و by the time و after لربط الأحداث. والعكس مع no sooner...than و hardly...when رسمي.
rules.syntax: As soon as / Once / By the time + clause. / No sooner had + subject + p.p. + than...

examples.en: As soon as I got home, I called her.
examples.ar: بمجرد وصولي إلى المنزل اتصلت بها.

examples.en: The moment he saw me, he smiled.
By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
examples.ar: بحلول وصولنا كان المحل قد أغلق.

examples.en: Once she had finished, she left.
No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
examples.ar: ما إن جلست حتى رن الهاتف.

examples.en: Hardly had he arrived when it started to rain.
examples.ar: لم يكد يصل حتى بدأت تمطر.

examples.en: After she had left, I realised my mistake.
Until he called, I hadn't known.
Just as I was leaving, she arrived.
Whenever it rained, we stayed inside.

rules.explanation_en: Use would + base verb for repeated actions in the past. Do not use would for states: use used to (I used to have a dog).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم would + فعل أساسي للأحداث المتكررة في الماضي. ولا نستخدم would مع الحالات؛ نستخدم used to (I used to have a dog).
rules.syntax: Subject + would + base verb (actions). / used to (states).

examples.en: When I was a child, we would visit my grandparents every summer.
examples.ar: عندما كنت طفلًا كنا نزور أجدادي كل صيف.

examples.en: Every morning he would walk along the river.
examples.ar: كل صباح كان يمشي على طول النهر.

examples.en: She would sing while she cooked.
We would play outside until it got dark.
examples.ar: كنا نلعب في الخارج حتى يحل الظلام.

examples.en: My father would tell us stories at night.
examples.ar: كان أبي يحكي لنا قصصًا ليلًا.

examples.en: They would often stay up late.
In winter we would sit by the fire.
examples.ar: في الشتاء كنا نجلس قرب النار.

examples.en: I used to have a dog.
She used to live near the sea.

rules.explanation_en: Use always, constantly or forever with the present or past continuous to show that a repeated action is annoying or surprising.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم always أو constantly أو forever مع المضارع أو الماضي المستمر لنبين أن الفعل المتكرر مزعج أو مفاجئ.
rules.syntax: Subject + be + always + verb-ing.

examples.en: He is always losing his keys.
My brother is constantly borrowing my things.
The neighbours are forever making noise.

rules.explanation_en: Use if + past perfect, would have + past participle for unreal situations in the past (things that did not happen).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم if + ماضٍ تام، would have + التصريف الثالث لمواقف غير حقيقية في الماضي (أشياء لم تحدث).
rules.syntax: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.ar: لو غادرت مبكرًا لما فاتها القطار.

examples.en: If we had known, we would have helped.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
He would have won if he had trained more.
If they had arrived on time, they would have seen it.
I wouldn't have bought it if I had known the price.
If you had told me, I would have come.
What would you have done if you had lost?
If he hadn't been ill, he would have attended.

rules.explanation_en: Mix a past condition with a present result (if + past perfect, would + base verb), or a present condition with a past result (if + past simple, would have + p.p.).
rules.explanation_ar: نخلط شرطًا ماضيًا بنتيجة حاضرة (if + ماضٍ تام، would + فعل أساسي)، أو شرطًا حاضرًا بنتيجة ماضية (if + ماضٍ بسيط، would have + التصريف الثالث).
rules.syntax: If + past perfect, would + base verb. / If + past simple, would have + p.p.

examples.en: If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.
examples.ar: لو كنت قبلت الوظيفة لكنت غنيًا الآن.

examples.en: If she hadn't moved, she would still live here.
examples.ar: لو لم تنتقل لظلت تعيش هنا.

examples.en: If I were taller, I would have joined the team.
examples.ar: لو كنت أطول لانضممت إلى الفريق.

examples.en: If he had studied medicine, he would be a doctor now.
examples.ar: لو درس الطب لكان طبيبًا الآن.

examples.en: If we had saved money, we wouldn't be in trouble.
examples.ar: لو وفرنا المال لما كنا في مشكلة.

examples.en: If you weren't so lazy, you would have finished.
If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
examples.ar: لو تناولت الفطور لما كنت جائعًا الآن.

examples.en: If they had listened, they would know the answer.
She would be here if she hadn't missed the flight.
examples.ar: كانت ستكون هنا لو لم تفتها الرحلة.

examples.en: If I knew French, I would have got the job.
examples.ar: لو كنت أعرف الفرنسية لحصلت على الوظيفة.

rules.explanation_en: Use must for strong certainty (positive), can't for strong certainty (negative), and might/may/could for possibility.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم must لليقين القوي (مثبت)، و can't لليقين القوي (منفي)، و might/may/could للاحتمال.
rules.syntax: Subject + must/can't/might + be (+ verb-ing).

examples.ar: لا يمكن أن يكون ذلك صحيحًا.

examples.en: He could be in the library.
The phone is ringing. It must be Ali.
examples.ar: الهاتف يرن. لا بد أنه علي.

examples.en: He can't be forty; he looks twenty.
examples.ar: لا يمكن أن يكون في الأربعين؛ يبدو في العشرين.

rules.explanation_en: Use modal + have + past participle: must have (certain), can't/couldn't have (impossible), might/may/could have (possible).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم modal + have + التصريف الثالث: must have (مؤكد) و can't/couldn't have (مستحيل) و might/may/could have (ممكن).
rules.syntax: Subject + must/can't/might + have + past participle.

examples.en: They might have missed the bus.
It could have been a mistake.
She can't have finished so quickly.
examples.ar: لا يمكن أنها أنهت بهذه السرعة.

examples.en: The thieves must have come in through the window.
examples.ar: لا بد أن اللصوص دخلوا من النافذة.

examples.en: I must have left my keys at work.
examples.ar: لا بد أنني تركت مفاتيحي في العمل.

rules.explanation_en: Use should have + past participle to say what was the right thing to do in the past (regret or criticism).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم should have + التصريف الثالث لنقول ما كان ينبغي فعله في الماضي (ندم أو انتقاد).
rules.syntax: Subject + should(n't) have + past participle.

examples.ar: ما كان ينبغي أن تقول ذلك.

examples.en: He should have listened to his doctor.
I shouldn't have eaten so much.
examples.ar: ما كان ينبغي أن آكل كثيرًا.

examples.en: You should have told me earlier.
Should I have taken the bus?
examples.ar: هل كان ينبغي أن أركب الحافلة؟

rules.rule: Wish and if only with the past perfect
rules.explanation_en: Use wish / if only + past perfect to express regret about the past. Regret + verb-ing means you are sorry about something you did.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم wish / if only + ماضٍ تام للتعبير عن الندم على الماضي. و regret + فعل ing تعني أنك نادم على شيء فعلته.
rules.syntax: Subject + wish + subject + past perfect. / If only + past perfect.

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
She wishes she hadn't said it.
I wish we had left earlier.
He wishes he had learned English as a child.
examples.ar: يتمنى لو تعلم الإنجليزية في طفولته.

examples.en: If only they had told us!
I wish I hadn't spent so much money.
examples.ar: أتمنى لو لم أنفق كل هذا المال.

examples.en: She wishes she had taken the job.

rules.explanation_en: Use if + present simple, present simple for facts and things that are always true. If can be replaced by when.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم if + مضارع بسيط، مضارع بسيط للحقائق والأشياء الصحيحة دائمًا. ويمكن استبدال if بـ when.
rules.syntax: If + present simple, present simple.

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
examples.ar: إذا مزجت الأحمر والأزرق حصلت على البنفسجي.

examples.en: Water boils if you heat it to 100 degrees.
examples.ar: يغلي الماء إذا سخنته إلى 100 درجة.

examples.en: If I'm tired, I go to bed early.
When it rains, the streets flood.
If you press this button, the door opens.
examples.ar: إذا ضغطت هذا الزر ينفتح الباب.

examples.en: If people don't drink, they get thirsty.
If you need help, call me.
examples.ar: إذا احتجت إلى مساعدة اتصل بي.

examples.en: Call me if you need anything.
examples.ar: اتصل بي إن احتجت إلى أي شيء.

examples.en: If it's Friday, we visit my parents.
examples.ar: إذا كان يوم الجمعة نزور والدي.

rules.rule: As long as, provided, otherwise, unless
rules.explanation_en: As long as and provided (that) mean only if. Otherwise and or else mean if not. In case means as a precaution.
rules.explanation_ar: as long as و provided (that) تعنيان فقط إذا. و otherwise و or else تعنيان وإلا. و in case تعني احتياطًا.
rules.syntax: as long as / provided that + clause. / ..., otherwise + clause.

examples.en: You can go as long as you come back early.
examples.ar: يمكنك الذهاب بشرط أن تعود مبكرًا.

examples.en: I'll lend you the car provided that you drive carefully.
examples.ar: سأعيرك السيارة بشرط أن تقود بحذر.

examples.en: Take a coat, otherwise you'll be cold.
Hurry up, or else we'll miss the bus.
Supposing you won, what would you do?
I'll come on condition that you pay.
Even if it rains, we'll go.
Only if you promise will I tell you.
In case it rains, take an umbrella.
As long as you're happy, I'm happy.

rules.explanation_en: Some reporting verbs are followed by verb-ing: admit, deny, suggest, regret. Others need a preposition + -ing: apologise for, accuse of, insist on, congratulate on, thank for, blame for.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض أفعال النقل يتبعها فعل ing: admit و deny و suggest و regret. وبعضها يحتاج حرف جر + ing: apologise for و accuse of و insist on و congratulate on و thank for و blame for.
rules.syntax: admit/deny/suggest + verb-ing. / verb + person + preposition + verb-ing.

examples.en: He blamed me for the mistake.

rules.explanation_en: Some verbs are followed by to + verb: promise, refuse, agree, offer, threaten. Others take an object + to + verb: warn, advise, remind, invite, encourage.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال يتبعها to + فعل: promise و refuse و agree و offer و threaten. وبعضها يأخذ مفعولًا + to + فعل: warn و advise و remind و invite و encourage.
rules.syntax: promise/refuse/agree + to + verb. / advise/warn/remind + person + to + verb.

examples.en: He warned me not to go.
The teacher reminded us to bring books.
He invited me to join them.
She offered to carry my bag.

rules.explanation_en: Use it is said/believed/thought that... or subject + is said/believed/thought to + verb to report general opinions. Use to have + p.p. for earlier events.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم it is said/believed/thought that... أو الفاعل + is said/believed/thought to + فعل لنقل الآراء العامة. ونستخدم to have + التصريف الثالث للأحداث الأسبق.
rules.syntax: It is said that + clause. / Subject + is said to + verb.

examples.en: It is said that he is rich.
He is said to be rich.
It is believed that the water is safe.
The water is believed to be safe.
She is thought to have left the country.
It is reported that three people were injured.
The man is known to be dangerous.
They are said to have won a lot of money.
It is expected that prices will rise.
He is considered to be an expert.

rules.explanation_en: Use have/get + object + past participle when someone else does a service for you, or when something happens to you (often bad).
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/get + مفعول + التصريف الثالث عندما يؤدي شخص آخر خدمة لك، أو عندما يحدث لك شيء (غالبًا سيئ).
rules.syntax: have/get + object + past participle.

examples.en: She has her hair cut every month.
We are having the house painted.
I need to have my eyes tested.
Where do you have your hair cut?
They had a new kitchen fitted.
She got her bag stolen on the bus.
Have you had your teeth checked?

rules.explanation_en: Use am/is/are/was/were + being + past participle for actions in progress. Use being + p.p. after prepositions and verbs like like, hate, remember.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are/was/were + being + التصريف الثالث للأحداث الجارية. ونستخدم being + التصريف الثالث بعد حروف الجر وأفعال مثل like و hate و remember.
rules.syntax: be + being + past participle.

examples.en: The new bridge is being built.
The students are being tested now.
Our house is being painted this week.
A new school was being built last year.
examples.ar: كانت مدرسة جديدة تُبنى العام الماضي.

examples.en: He didn't like being laughed at.
I remember being taken to the zoo.
examples.ar: أتذكر أنني أُخذت إلى حديقة الحيوان.

rules.explanation_en: Use to be + past participle after verbs like want, hope, need, expect and after adjectives. Use to have been + p.p. for earlier events.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم to be + التصريف الثالث بعد أفعال مثل want و hope و need و expect وبعد الصفات. ونستخدم to have been + التصريف الثالث للأحداث الأسبق.
rules.syntax: to be + past participle. / to have been + past participle.

examples.en: The work has to be done.
He wants to be told the truth.
The house needs to be cleaned.
I expect to be paid on Friday.
examples.ar: أتوقع أن يُدفع لي يوم الجمعة.

examples.en: The package is to be delivered tomorrow.
There is a lot to be done.
He seems to have been forgotten.
She is expected to be promoted.
They were glad to be chosen.

rules.explanation_en: Formal writing often uses the passive and impersonal structures to sound objective: It is recommended that..., It should be noted that...
rules.explanation_ar: الكتابة الرسمية تستخدم غالبًا المبني للمجهول والتراكيب غير الشخصية لتبدو موضوعية: It is recommended that... و It should be noted that...
rules.syntax: It is + p.p. + that + clause. / Subject + must/will be + p.p.

examples.en: It is recommended that you arrive early.
It has been decided to close the office.
Passengers are requested to remain seated.
It should be noted that prices have risen.
examples.ar: تجدر الإشارة إلى أن الأسعار ارتفعت.

examples.en: Applications must be submitted by Friday.
It was found that most students preferred online classes.
examples.ar: وُجد أن معظم الطلاب فضلوا الدروس عبر الإنترنت.

examples.en: It is widely believed that exercise is healthy.
examples.ar: يُعتقد على نطاق واسع أن الرياضة صحية.

examples.en: A meeting will be held next week.
Further details can be found on our website.
examples.ar: يمكن الاطلاع على مزيد من التفاصيل على موقعنا.

rules.explanation_en: Formal English uses Latin-based verbs instead of everyday phrasal verbs: begin -> commence, buy -> purchase, need -> require, get -> obtain, ask -> enquire.
rules.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية الرسمية تستخدم أفعالًا ذات أصل لاتيني بدل الأفعال اليومية: begin -> commence و buy -> purchase و need -> require و get -> obtain و ask -> enquire.
rules.syntax: Informal verb -> formal verb.

examples.en: We will commence the meeting at nine.
I would like to purchase a ticket.
Please inform us of any changes.
You can obtain a form at reception.
examples.ar: يمكنك الحصول على استمارة من الاستقبال.

examples.en: I am writing to enquire about prices.
I am writing regarding your order.

rules.explanation_en: Use phrases like in my view, it could be argued that, on the one hand... on the other hand to present and balance arguments.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم عبارات مثل in my view و it could be argued that و on the one hand... on the other hand لعرض الحجج وموازنتها.
rules.syntax: In my view, + clause. / On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...

examples.en: In my view, children should wear uniforms.
examples.ar: في رأيي ينبغي أن يرتدي الأطفال الزي الموحد.

examples.en: I strongly believe that education is a right.
It could be argued that technology helps learning.
examples.ar: يمكن القول إن التكنولوجيا تساعد على التعلم.

examples.en: Some people claim that money brings happiness.
examples.ar: يزعم بعض الناس أن المال يجلب السعادة.

examples.en: On the one hand, cars are convenient. On the other hand, they pollute.
examples.ar: من ناحية السيارات مريحة ومن ناحية أخرى تلوّث.

examples.en: One advantage is that it saves time.
A major disadvantage is the cost.
There are arguments for and against.
Many people are in favour of the idea.

rules.explanation_en: Concede a point before giving your own view: admittedly, it is true that, granted, nevertheless, even so, all the same.
rules.explanation_ar: نعترف بنقطة قبل إبداء رأينا: admittedly و it is true that و granted و nevertheless و even so و all the same.
rules.syntax: Admittedly, + clause, but + clause. / Nevertheless, + clause.

examples.en: Admittedly, it is expensive, but it is worth it.
It is true that he is young, but he is talented.
Although it may seem difficult, it is possible.
examples.ar: رغم أنه قد يبدو صعبًا فهو ممكن.

examples.en: That may be true, but I disagree.
examples.ar: قد يكون ذلك صحيحًا لكنني لا أتفق.

examples.en: Even so, I would still go.
All the same, it was a good trip.
While I understand your point, I think you are wrong.
examples.ar: رغم أنني أفهم وجهة نظرك أعتقد أنك مخطئ.

examples.en: However, we should consider the cost.

rules.explanation_en: A good introduction attracts attention, gives background, and states the purpose of the essay (thesis).
rules.explanation_ar: المقدمة الجيدة تجذب الانتباه وتعطي خلفية وتذكر هدف المقال (الفكرة الرئيسية).
rules.syntax: General statement + background + In this essay, I will...

examples.en: These days, many people work from home.
examples.ar: في هذه الأيام يعمل كثير من الناس من المنزل.

examples.en: It is often said that money cannot buy happiness.
examples.ar: كثيرًا ما يقال إن المال لا يشتري السعادة.

examples.en: In this essay, I will discuss both sides.
This essay will examine the causes of pollution.
Nowadays, technology plays an important role in our lives.
examples.ar: في وقتنا الحالي تلعب التكنولوجيا دورًا مهمًا في حياتنا.

examples.en: Is it better to live in a city or in the countryside?
examples.ar: هل من الأفضل العيش في المدينة أم الريف؟

examples.en: I would like to argue that exams are unfair.
examples.ar: أود أن أجادل بأن الامتحانات غير عادلة.

examples.en: There is a growing debate about social media.
examples.ar: هناك جدل متزايد حول وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

examples.en: Many people believe that cars should be banned.
examples.ar: يعتقد كثيرون أن السيارات ينبغي حظرها.

examples.en: This essay looks at the advantages and disadvantages.

rules.explanation_en: Each paragraph has one main idea (topic sentence) followed by support and examples. End with a conclusion that summarises.
rules.explanation_ar: كل فقرة فيها فكرة رئيسية (جملة موضوع) تليها أدلة وأمثلة. وننهي بخاتمة تلخص.
rules.syntax: Topic sentence + support + example. / To conclude, ...

examples.en: For instance, many students use phones in class.
examples.ar: على سبيل المثال يستخدم كثير من الطلاب الهواتف في الفصل.

examples.en: This shows that change is needed.
As a result, many people lose their jobs.
examples.ar: ونتيجة لذلك يفقد كثير من الناس وظائفهم.

examples.en: To conclude, there are strong arguments on both sides.
examples.ar: في الختام هناك حجج قوية على الجانبين.

examples.en: All things considered, I think it is a good idea.
examples.ar: بالنظر إلى كل شيء أعتقد أنها فكرة جيدة.

examples.en: In summary, the benefits outweigh the risks.
For these reasons, I believe we should act.
examples.ar: لهذه الأسباب أعتقد أن علينا أن نتصرف.

rules.explanation_en: Hedging makes statements less absolute and more careful: seem, appear, tend to, may, could, suggest, indicate.
rules.explanation_ar: التحوط يجعل العبارات أقل إطلاقًا وأكثر حذرًا: seem و appear و tend to و may و could و suggest و indicate.
rules.syntax: It seems/appears that + clause. / Subject + tend(s) to + verb.

examples.en: It seems that prices are rising.
This appears to be a problem.
The results suggest that exercise helps.
examples.ar: تشير النتائج إلى أن الرياضة تفيد.

examples.en: It may be that he is tired.
Students tend to work harder in groups.
examples.ar: يميل الطلاب إلى العمل بجد أكبر في مجموعات.

examples.en: This could be due to stress.
It is likely that prices will fall.
There is some evidence that sleep affects memory.
examples.ar: هناك بعض الأدلة على أن النوم يؤثر في الذاكرة.

examples.en: Perhaps the plan is too expensive.
The data indicate a possible link.

rules.explanation_en: Use in general, on the whole, by and large, to some extent and most people instead of all people to avoid over-generalising.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم in general و on the whole و by and large و to some extent و most people بدل all people لتجنب التعميم المطلق.
rules.syntax: In general, + clause. / Most/Many + plural noun + verb.

examples.en: In general, people prefer cheaper products.
On the whole, the trip was successful.
To some extent, he is right.
By and large, students enjoy the course.
Most people agree that health is important.
examples.ar: يتفق معظم الناس على أن الصحة مهمة.

examples.en: In most cases, the system works well.
examples.ar: في معظم الحالات يعمل النظام جيدًا.

examples.en: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
examples.ar: بوجه عام تعيش النساء أطول من الرجال.

examples.en: Some people think it is unfair.
examples.ar: يعتقد بعض الناس أنه غير عادل.

examples.en: A large number of people are worried.
Many experts believe the problem is serious.
examples.ar: يعتقد كثير من الخبراء أن المشكلة خطيرة.

rules.explanation_en: Use because of / due to + noun, lead to / result in + noun, and therefore / consequently / as a result to show results.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم because of / due to + اسم و lead to / result in + اسم و therefore / consequently / as a result لإظهار النتائج.
rules.syntax: because of / due to + noun. / A leads to B. / Therefore, + clause.

examples.en: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
Due to the rain, the match was postponed.
The accident was caused by bad weather.
As a result of the strike, trains stopped.
The bad weather resulted in long delays.
examples.ar: أدى الطقس السيئ إلى تأخيرات طويلة.

examples.en: Pollution has an effect on health.
Consequently, many people lost their jobs.
The reason for the delay was the traffic.

rules.explanation_en: Use whereas, while, unlike and in contrast to show differences. Use similarly, like, both and compared with to show similarities.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم whereas و while و unlike و in contrast to لإظهار الاختلافات. ونستخدم similarly و like و both و compared with لإظهار التشابه.
rules.syntax: A whereas B. / Unlike A, B... / Both A and B...

examples.en: Cars are fast, whereas bicycles are cheap.
While Cairo is busy, Luxor is quiet.
Unlike his brother, he is shy.
In contrast, the north is cold.
Like her mother, she is tall.
Compared with last year, sales are higher.
The two phones are similar in price.
On the other hand, trains are slower.

lessons.title: Phrasal Verbs: Separable and Inseparable
lessons.title_ar: الأفعال المركبة: القابلة للفصل وغير القابلة

rules.explanation_en: With separable phrasal verbs the object can go between the verb and the particle. A pronoun object must go in the middle (turn it off, not turn off it).
rules.explanation_ar: في الأفعال المركبة القابلة للفصل يمكن وضع المفعول بين الفعل والحرف. وضمير المفعول يجب أن يكون في الوسط (turn it off وليس turn off it).
rules.syntax: verb + object + particle. / verb + particle + noun.

rules.explanation_en: With inseparable phrasal verbs the object always comes after the particle: look after, look for, run into, get over, put up with.
rules.explanation_ar: في الأفعال المركبة غير القابلة للفصل يأتي المفعول دائمًا بعد الحرف: look after و look for و run into و get over و put up with.
rules.syntax: verb + particle + object (never in the middle).

examples.en: We ran into an old friend.
I can't put up with the noise.
She came across an old photo.

rules.explanation_en: Many phrasal verbs are common in the workplace: set up, take on, hand in, call off, put off, step down, run out of, sort out, carry on, lay off.
rules.explanation_ar: كثير من الأفعال المركبة شائع في العمل: set up و take on و hand in و call off و put off و step down و run out of و sort out و carry on و lay off.
rules.syntax: verb + particle (+ object).

examples.en: She set up her own company.
We need to take on more staff.
examples.ar: نحتاج إلى توظيف المزيد من الموظفين.

examples.en: Please hand in your report by Friday.
She was laid off last year.

rules.explanation_en: Three-part phrasal verbs have a verb + adverb + preposition. They are inseparable: look forward to, come up with, put up with, get on with.
rules.explanation_ar: الأفعال المركبة الثلاثية فيها فعل + ظرف + حرف جر. وهي غير قابلة للفصل: look forward to و come up with و put up with و get on with.
rules.syntax: verb + adverb + preposition + object.

examples.en: I'm looking forward to the holiday.
She came up with a great idea.
We can't put up with this any longer.
I look up to my father.
She is catching up with the class.
We've come up against a problem.
Don't let anyone talk you out of it.
I'll get back to you tomorrow.

rules.explanation_en: Some verbs go naturally with certain nouns: make a decision, do homework, take a break, have a shower. Learn them as chunks.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال تأتي طبيعيًا مع أسماء معينة: make a decision و do homework و take a break و have a shower. نتعلمها كوحدات.
rules.syntax: make / do / take / have + noun.

examples.en: I do my homework after school.
I do the shopping on Saturday.

rules.explanation_en: Choose natural partners: heavy traffic (not strong traffic), strong coffee, deeply sorry, highly successful, bitterly cold, fully aware.
rules.explanation_ar: نختار الكلمات المتلازمة بشكل طبيعي: heavy traffic (وليس strong traffic) و strong coffee و deeply sorry و highly successful و bitterly cold و fully aware.
rules.syntax: adjective + noun. / adverb + adjective.

examples.en: There was heavy traffic this morning.
examples.ar: كان هناك ازدحام شديد هذا الصباح.

examples.en: He is fully aware of the risks.

rules.explanation_en: Idioms have a meaning that is different from the words. Learn them as complete phrases and do not translate them word by word.
rules.explanation_ar: التعابير الاصطلاحية لها معنى مختلف عن الكلمات. نتعلمها كعبارات كاملة ولا نترجمها كلمة بكلمة.
rules.syntax: Fixed phrase (do not change the words).

examples.en: It cost an arm and a leg.
It happens once in a blue moon.
You hit the nail on the head.

examples.ar: أن تصل متأخرًا خير من ألا تصل.

rules.explanation_en: Prefixes (un-, im-, dis-) change the meaning. Suffixes (-er, -ful, -less, -ion, -ment, -ship) change the word class (verb, noun, adjective).
rules.explanation_ar: البادئات (un و im و dis) تغير المعنى. واللواحق (er و ful و less و ion و ment و ship) تغير نوع الكلمة (فعل أو اسم أو صفة).
rules.syntax: prefix + word / word + suffix.

rules.explanation_en: Start by welcoming the audience, say the topic, and explain the structure so the audience can follow you.
rules.explanation_ar: نبدأ بالترحيب بالجمهور ثم نذكر الموضوع ونشرح البنية ليتمكن الجمهور من المتابعة.
rules.syntax: Today I'm going to + verb. / My talk has + number + parts.

examples.en: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming.
Today I'm going to talk about sales.
Then I'll look at the results.
Let's begin with the main points.
I'd like to start by showing you a chart.
examples.ar: أود أن أبدأ بإظهار رسم بياني لكم.

examples.en: The aim of this talk is to explain our plan.
Feel free to ask questions at any time.
examples.ar: لا تترددوا في طرح الأسئلة في أي وقت.

rules.explanation_en: Refer to slides and charts clearly, move between points with signposting language, and close with a summary and an invitation to ask questions.
rules.explanation_ar: نشير إلى الشرائح والرسوم بوضوح وننتقل بين النقاط بعبارات توجيهية ونختم بملخص ودعوة لطرح الأسئلة.
rules.syntax: As you can see... / Moving on to... / To sum up...

examples.en: As you can see on this slide, sales have risen.
examples.ar: كما ترون في هذه الشريحة ارتفعت المبيعات.

examples.en: This graph shows a clear increase.
Let me draw your attention to this figure.
examples.ar: اسمحوا لي أن ألفت انتباهكم إلى هذا الرقم.

examples.en: Moving on to the next point...
That brings me to my last point.
To sum up, we have three main results.
In conclusion, the project was a success.
I'll be happy to answer them.

rules.rule: Running a meeting and giving opinions
rules.explanation_en: Use fixed phrases to open a meeting, follow the agenda, interrupt politely and make suggestions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم عبارات ثابتة لافتتاح الاجتماع واتباع جدول الأعمال والمقاطعة بأدب وتقديم الاقتراحات.
rules.syntax: Let's get started. / Could I add something? / Sorry to interrupt, but...

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
examples.ar: البند الأول في جدول الأعمال هو الميزانية.

examples.en: Could we move on to the next point?
examples.ar: هل يمكننا الانتقال إلى النقطة التالية؟

examples.en: If I may, I'd like to make a suggestion.
Sorry to interrupt, but I have a question.
Could I just finish my point?
We are running out of time.

rules.explanation_en: Ask for clarification politely, paraphrase to check that you understood, and agree or disagree tactfully.
rules.explanation_ar: نطلب التوضيح بأدب ونعيد الصياغة للتأكد من الفهم ونوافق أو نخالف بلباقة.
rules.syntax: Could you clarify...? / So what you're saying is...

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean?
So what you're saying is that we should wait?
examples.ar: إذن ما تقوله هو أننا ينبغي أن ننتظر؟

examples.en: Could you give us an example?
Let me make sure I understand.
Let's summarise what we have agreed.

rules.explanation_en: Use could, would be willing to, if + present, will, and provided that to make offers with conditions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم could و would be willing to و if + مضارع + will و provided that لتقديم عروض مشروطة.
rules.syntax: We can offer you... / If you..., we'll... / Provided that...

examples.en: We can offer you a ten per cent discount.
examples.ar: يمكننا أن نعرض عليك خصمًا بنسبة عشرة بالمئة.

examples.en: If you order more, we'll lower the price.
We could deliver by Friday if you pay today.
examples.ar: يمكننا التسليم بحلول الجمعة إذا دفعت اليوم.

examples.en: We would be willing to extend the contract.
Provided you sign today, we'll include free delivery.
examples.ar: بشرط أن توقع اليوم سنشمل التوصيل المجاني.

examples.en: What if we split the cost?
Would you consider a longer contract?

rules.explanation_en: Soften a refusal with I'm afraid or I'm sorry, but. Suggest a compromise with perhaps we could or what if.
rules.explanation_ar: نخفف الرفض بـ I'm afraid أو I'm sorry, but. ونقترح حلًا وسطًا بـ perhaps we could أو what if.
rules.syntax: I'm afraid + clause. / Perhaps we could + verb.

examples.ar: ربما يمكننا الالتقاء في منتصف الطريق.

examples.en: We can't go any lower than that.
examples.ar: لا يمكننا النزول أكثر من ذلك.

examples.en: I'm sorry, but we can't accept that.
examples.ar: آسف لكن لا يمكننا قبول ذلك.

examples.en: Can we come back to this later?
examples.ar: هل يمكننا العودة إلى هذا لاحقًا؟

examples.en: I'll have to consult my manager.

rules.rule: B2 review: tenses, conditionals and modals
rules.explanation_en: Review the main B2 patterns: future perfect and continuous, past perfect continuous, third and mixed conditionals, and modals of deduction and regret.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة أهم أنماط B2: المستقبل التام والمستمر والماضي التام المستمر والشرط الثالث والمختلط والأفعال الناقصة للاستنتاج والندم.
rules.syntax: Choose the structure that matches the time and meaning.

examples.en: By next year I will have finished my degree.
examples.ar: بحلول العام القادم سأكون قد أنهيت دراستي.

examples.en: She had been waiting for an hour when he arrived.
examples.ar: كانت تنتظر منذ ساعة عندما وصل.

examples.en: If I had known, I would have told you.
If I were you, I wouldn't go.
I wish I had studied harder.
This time tomorrow I'll be flying.
examples.ar: في مثل هذا الوقت غدًا سأكون مسافرًا.

examples.en: She can't be at work; it's Friday.
examples.ar: لا يمكن أن تكون في العمل؛ إنه الجمعة.

examples.en: As long as you try, you'll improve.

rules.rule: B2 review: passive, reporting and linking
rules.explanation_en: Review the passive, reporting verbs, formal structures, hedging and linking words from this level.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة المبني للمجهول وأفعال النقل والتراكيب الرسمية والتحوط وأدوات الربط في هذا المستوى.
rules.syntax: Choose the structure that matches the style: formal or informal.

examples.en: He is said to be very rich.
I had my hair cut yesterday.
They agreed to meet on Monday.
The meeting was called off due to illness.
Whereas some people prefer cities, others like villages.
examples.ar: بينما يفضل بعض الناس المدن يحب آخرون القرى.

examples.en: It seems that prices will rise.
In conclusion, the plan is worth trying.

final_test.question: I was tired because I ___ all day.
final_test.question_ar: كنت متعبًا لأنني كنت أعمل طوال اليوم.

final_test.question: If I ___ earlier, I would have caught the train.
final_test.question_ar: لو غادرت مبكرًا لكنت لحقت بالقطار.

final_test.question: He ___ be at home; his car is outside.
final_test.question_ar: لا بد أنه في المنزل؛ سيارته في الخارج.

final_test.question: You ___ told me! I'd have helped.
final_test.question_ar: كان ينبغي أن تخبرني! كنت سأساعدك.

final_test.question: ___ it is expensive, it is worth it.

rules.explanation_en: After negative or restrictive adverbials (never, rarely, seldom, hardly, no sooner, not only, under no circumstances, little, only then) put an auxiliary verb before the subject. This is formal and emphatic.
rules.explanation_ar: بعد الظروف المنفية أو المقيِّدة (never و rarely و seldom و hardly و no sooner و not only و under no circumstances و little و only then) نضع الفعل المساعد قبل الفاعل. وهذا رسمي وللتوكيد.
rules.syntax: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + main verb.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.ar: لم أرَ قط مكانًا بهذا الجمال.

examples.en: Rarely does he arrive on time.
Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang.
examples.ar: لم تكد تجلس حتى رن الهاتف.

examples.en: No sooner had we left than it started to rain.
examples.ar: ما إن غادرنا حتى بدأت تمطر.

examples.en: Not only did he lie, but he also stole.
examples.ar: لم يكذب فحسب بل سرق أيضًا.

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
examples.ar: تحت أي ظرف لا ينبغي أن تفتح هذا الباب.

examples.en: Never before had I felt so nervous.
examples.ar: لم أشعر من قبل بمثل هذا التوتر.

examples.en: Little did they know about the danger.
examples.ar: لم يكونوا يعلمون شيئًا عن الخطر.

examples.en: Only then did I understand the problem.

rules.explanation_en: In formal English, drop if and invert the subject and auxiliary: Had + subject + p.p., Were + subject, Should + subject + verb.
rules.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية الرسمية نحذف if ونقلب الفاعل والفعل المساعد: Had + فاعل + التصريف الثالث و Were + فاعل و Should + فاعل + فعل.
rules.syntax: Had/Were/Should + subject (+ verb), main clause.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have helped.
Were he here, he would agree.
Should you need help, call me.
examples.ar: إن احتجت إلى مساعدة فاتصل بي.

examples.en: Had she studied, she would have passed.
Were I you, I would accept.
Should anything go wrong, let us know.
Had they arrived earlier, they would have seen him.
Should you change your mind, tell me.
Were it not for the rain, we would go out.
Had it not been for you, I would have failed.

rules.explanation_en: Use It + be + focus + that/who to emphasise one part of a sentence. The emphasised part comes after it is/was.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم It + be + الجزء المؤكَّد + that/who لتوكيد جزء من الجملة. ويأتي الجزء المؤكَّد بعد it is/was.
rules.syntax: It + is/was + focus + that/who + rest.

examples.en: It was John who broke the window.
It is money that causes problems.
It was in Cairo that we met.
It was last year that she moved.
It is your attitude that bothers me.
It was my sister who called.
It isn't the price that matters.
It was only then that I realised.
It was the noise that woke me up.
It is quality we look for.

rules.explanation_en: Use What... is/was... to put the new information at the end for emphasis. All... is... and The thing that... is... work in the same way.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم What... is/was... لنضع المعلومة الجديدة في الآخر للتوكيد. وتعمل All... is... و The thing that... is... بنفس الطريقة.
rules.syntax: What + subject + verb + is/was + focus.

examples.en: What I need is a holiday.
What she wants is more time.
What annoys me is his laziness.
What we did was call the police.
The thing that worries me is the cost.
What happened was that the power went out.
examples.ar: ما حدث هو أن الكهرباء انقطعت.

examples.en: The place where we met was Cairo.
examples.ar: المكان الذي التقينا فيه كان القاهرة.

examples.en: What I like about her is her honesty.

rules.explanation_en: Move an element to the front of the sentence for emphasis or style. This is common in formal and literary writing: Such was..., So + adjective + was..., On the table lay...
rules.explanation_ar: ننقل عنصرًا إلى بداية الجملة للتوكيد أو الأسلوب. وهذا شائع في الكتابة الرسمية والأدبية: Such was... و So + صفة + was... و On the table lay...
rules.syntax: Fronted element + verb + subject.

examples.en: Such was his anger that he left.
examples.ar: كان غضبه شديدًا لدرجة أنه غادر.

examples.en: So difficult was the exam that many failed.
examples.ar: كان الامتحان صعبًا لدرجة أن كثيرين رسبوا.

examples.en: On the table lay a small box.
examples.ar: على الطاولة كان يوجد صندوق صغير.

examples.en: In the corner stood an old clock.
examples.ar: في الزاوية كانت تقف ساعة قديمة.

examples.en: Of all the cities I visited, Rome was my favourite.
examples.ar: من بين كل المدن التي زرتها كانت روما المفضلة لدي.

examples.en: Gone are the days of cheap travel.
Especially important is the first step.
examples.ar: الأهم بشكل خاص هو الخطوة الأولى.

examples.en: Strange as it may seem, I enjoyed it.
examples.ar: مهما بدا غريبًا فقد استمتعت به.

rules.explanation_en: Use do/does/did + base verb for emphasis (I do like it). Use strong intensifiers with extreme adjectives: absolutely, utterly, completely.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم do/does/did + فعل أساسي للتوكيد (I do like it). ونستخدم مكثفات قوية مع الصفات القصوى: absolutely و utterly و completely.
rules.syntax: do/does/did + base verb. / absolutely/utterly + extreme adjective.

examples.en: She did say she would come.
It was a truly amazing experience.
He is by far the best player.

rules.explanation_en: Discourse markers organise speech and show attitude: frankly, to be honest, actually, as a matter of fact, basically, anyway, incidentally.
rules.explanation_ar: أدوات الخطاب تنظم الكلام وتظهر الموقف: frankly و to be honest و actually و as a matter of fact و basically و anyway و incidentally.
rules.syntax: Marker, + clause.

examples.en: Frankly, I don't think it will work.
To be honest, I was surprised.
As a matter of fact, I live there.
Basically, it's a question of money.
Believe it or not, I won.
To tell you the truth, I'm tired.

rules.explanation_en: Modify comparatives with far, considerably, slightly, a good deal, nowhere near, by far and by no means.
rules.explanation_ar: نعدّل صيغ المقارنة بـ far و considerably و slightly و a good deal و nowhere near و by far و by no means.
rules.syntax: far/slightly + comparative. / by far the + superlative.

examples.en: This is far better than the last one.
It is nowhere near as good.
She is by far the most talented.
There are considerably more people today.
The film was nothing like the book.
examples.ar: لم يكن الفيلم يشبه الكتاب إطلاقًا.

examples.en: He is no more qualified than I am.
It is by no means easy.
The second test was a good deal harder.
Far fewer people came than expected.
examples.ar: جاء أناس أقل بكثير مما كان متوقعًا.

rules.explanation_en: After verbs and adjectives of demand, suggestion and importance (suggest, insist, recommend, essential, vital) use that + subject + base verb. There is no -s and no should is needed.
rules.explanation_ar: بعد أفعال وصفات الطلب والاقتراح والأهمية (suggest و insist و recommend و essential و vital) نستخدم that + فاعل + فعل أساسي. بدون s وبدون should.
rules.syntax: suggest/insist/recommend + that + subject + base verb.

examples.en: I suggest that he be present.
The doctor recommended that she rest.
It is essential that everyone attend.
They demanded that the manager resign.
I propose that we vote now.
It is vital that you arrive early.
The rule requires that all students wear uniforms.
examples.ar: تشترط القاعدة أن يرتدي جميع الطلاب الزي الموحد.

examples.en: He asked that she be informed.
We advise that you not travel.

rules.rule: Unreal past: it's time, would rather, as if
rules.explanation_en: Use the past simple (not past meaning) after it's time, would rather + subject, as if/as though, suppose. Use the past perfect for unreal past events.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط (بمعنى غير ماضٍ) بعد it's time و would rather + فاعل و as if/as though و suppose. ونستخدم الماضي التام لأحداث ماضية غير واقعية.
rules.syntax: It's time + subject + past simple. / would rather + subject + past simple.

examples.en: She talks as if she knew everything.
He behaves as though he owned the place.
It's high time you took a break.
Suppose you had a million, what would you do?
examples.ar: لنفترض أنك تملك مليونًا فماذا ستفعل؟

examples.en: I'd rather he had told me.
She looked as if she had seen a ghost.

rules.explanation_en: Use a present participle (-ing) clause to give a reason, a time, or an action at the same time as the main verb. The subject of both clauses must be the same.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم جملة فعل ing لإعطاء سبب أو وقت أو حدث يقع مع الفعل الرئيسي. ويجب أن يكون الفاعل في الجملتين واحدًا.
rules.syntax: Verb-ing + object, + subject + main verb.

examples.en: Walking home, I met an old friend.
examples.ar: وأنا أمشي إلى المنزل قابلت صديقًا قديمًا.

examples.en: Feeling tired, she went to bed.
Opening the door, he saw a stranger.
Not knowing the answer, I stayed silent.
examples.ar: لأنني لا أعرف الإجابة بقيت صامتًا.

examples.en: Seeing the police, the thief ran away.
Waiting for the bus, we chatted.
The man standing there is my uncle.
Having a lot of free time, he took up painting.
examples.ar: لأن لديه وقتًا فراغًا كبيرًا بدأ الرسم.

examples.en: Being a teacher, she understands children.
Turning the corner, I saw the shop.

rules.explanation_en: Use having + past participle for an action that happened before the main verb. Use a past participle (-ed) for a passive meaning.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم having + التصريف الثالث لحدث وقع قبل الفعل الرئيسي. ونستخدم التصريف الثالث لمعنى المبني للمجهول.
rules.syntax: Having + p.p., subject + verb. / Past participle + noun/subject + verb.

examples.en: Having finished his work, he went home.
examples.ar: بعد أن أنهى عمله ذهب إلى المنزل.

examples.en: Having lost his keys, he couldn't get in.
examples.ar: لأنه أضاع مفاتيحه لم يستطع الدخول.

examples.en: Written in 1990, the book is still popular.
examples.ar: الكتاب الذي كُتب عام 1990 ما زال شائعًا.

examples.en: Tired after the trip, she slept.
Built in the 18th century, the house is old.
examples.ar: المنزل الذي بُني في القرن الثامن عشر قديم.

examples.en: Given more time, I could finish.
Having been warned, he was careful.
Seen from above, the city looks small.
examples.ar: عند النظر إليها من الأعلى تبدو المدينة صغيرة.

examples.en: Compared with last year, sales rose.

rules.explanation_en: Leave out words that are clear from the context to avoid repetition. After and, but, or the subject and auxiliary can often be omitted or replaced with so/neither do I.
rules.explanation_ar: نحذف الكلمات الواضحة من السياق لتجنب التكرار. وبعد and و but و or يمكن حذف الفاعل والفعل المساعد أو استخدام so/neither do I.
rules.syntax: Auxiliary only (I can, and she can, too). / so + auxiliary + subject.

examples.en: I can swim and she can, too.
He wanted to go, but I didn't.
Do you want tea or coffee?
She said she would call, and she did.
I haven't seen it, but Ali has.
Can you help? I'd love to.
He is tired and so am I.

rules.rule: Substitution: so, not, do so, one
rules.explanation_en: Use so and not to replace a clause (I think so, I hope not). Use one/ones to replace a countable noun. Use do so to replace a verb phrase in formal English.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم so و not لاستبدال جملة (I think so و I hope not). ونستخدم one/ones لاستبدال اسم معدود. ونستخدم do so لاستبدال عبارة فعلية في الإنجليزية الرسمية.
rules.syntax: think/hope/say + so/not. / adjective + one(s).

examples.en: These shoes are old; I need new ones.
examples.ar: هذا الحذاء قديم؛ أحتاج إلى حذاء جديد.

examples.en: He asked me to leave, and I did so.

lessons.title: Modal Nuances and Future in the Past
lessons.title_ar: دقائق الأفعال الناقصة والمستقبل في الماضي

rules.explanation_en: Use was/were going to, would, was/were about to and was/were to for plans or predictions made in the past, whether or not they happened.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم was/were going to و would و was/were about to و was/were to للخطط أو التنبؤات التي وُضعت في الماضي، سواء تحققت أم لا.
rules.syntax: was/were going to / would / was about to + base verb.

examples.en: She was going to call, but she forgot.
I was about to leave when he arrived.
examples.ar: كنت على وشك المغادرة عندما وصل.

examples.en: We were to meet at six.
examples.ar: كان من المقرر أن نلتقي في السادسة.

examples.en: I knew it was going to rain.
They were just about to start.
I was going to tell you earlier.
The train was due to arrive at nine.
examples.ar: كان القطار مقررًا وصوله في التاسعة.

examples.en: He was on the point of crying.

rules.rule: Needn't, dare, may as well and more
rules.explanation_en: Needn't have + p.p. means something was done but was unnecessary. Dare and may/might as well are semi-modals with special uses.
rules.explanation_ar: needn't have + التصريف الثالث تعني أن شيئًا فُعل لكنه لم يكن ضروريًا. و dare و may/might as well أفعال شبه ناقصة لها استخدامات خاصة.
rules.syntax: needn't have + p.p. / may as well + base verb.

rules.explanation_en: Use verbs and adjective + noun pairs to describe change: rise/increase, fall/decline, fluctuate, peak, level off, dramatic/slight/steady + noun.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم أفعالًا وأزواج صفة + اسم لوصف التغير: rise/increase و fall/decline و fluctuate و peak و level off و dramatic/slight/steady + اسم.
rules.syntax: Subject + verb + adverb. / There was a + adjective + noun + in + subject.

examples.ar: ارتفعت المبيعات بشكل حاد في مارس.

examples.en: There was a slight decline in prices.
examples.ar: كان هناك انخفاض طفيف في الأسعار.

examples.en: There was a dramatic increase in sales.
examples.ar: كانت هناك زيادة كبيرة في المبيعات.

examples.en: The figure dropped to 40 per cent.

rules.explanation_en: Use account for, a majority/minority of, roughly a third of, the proportion of and one in five to describe amounts and proportions.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم account for و a majority/minority of و roughly a third of و the proportion of و one in five لوصف الكميات والنسب.
rules.syntax: Noun + account(s) for + percentage. / A majority of + plural noun + verb.

examples.en: Women account for 60 per cent of students.
A majority of people prefer online shopping.
examples.ar: تفضل أغلبية الناس التسوق عبر الإنترنت.

examples.en: Roughly a third of the staff work part-time.
examples.ar: حوالي ثلث الموظفين يعملون بدوام جزئي.

examples.en: Nearly half of the sample were students.
The proportion of elderly people is rising.
Over 70 per cent of respondents said yes.
examples.ar: أجاب أكثر من 70 بالمئة من المشاركين بنعم.

examples.en: One in five children is overweight.
examples.ar: واحد من كل خمسة أطفال يعاني من زيادة الوزن.

examples.en: The ratio of men to women is two to one.
examples.ar: نسبة الرجال إلى النساء اثنان إلى واحد.

rules.explanation_en: Use reporting verbs in the present simple to summarise a text: argue, outline, highlight, conclude, examine, claim, point out, discuss.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم أفعال النقل في المضارع البسيط لتلخيص نص: argue و outline و highlight و conclude و examine و claim و point out و discuss.
rules.syntax: The author/writer/study + summarising verb + (that) + clause.

examples.en: The author argues that education is a right.
The report outlines the main problems.
The writer highlights the role of families.
examples.ar: يسلط الكاتب الضوء على دور الأسر.

examples.en: The study concludes that exercise helps.
examples.ar: تخلص الدراسة إلى أن الرياضة مفيدة.

examples.en: The article examines the causes of poverty.
The text claims that technology is harmful.
The author points out that costs are rising.
examples.ar: يشير المؤلف إلى أن التكاليف ترتفع.

examples.en: According to the writer, the plan failed.
The study found that sleep matters.

rules.explanation_en: Paraphrase by changing vocabulary (synonyms), structure (active/passive, noun/verb), and word order, while keeping the same meaning.
rules.explanation_ar: نعيد الصياغة بتغيير المفردات (المرادفات) والبنية (مبني للمعلوم/للمجهول، اسم/فعل) وترتيب الكلمات مع الحفاظ على المعنى.
rules.syntax: Original -> paraphrase (same meaning, different words).

examples.en: The cost of living has risen. -> Living expenses have increased.
Many people are worried. -> A large number of individuals are concerned.
He gave up smoking. -> He abandoned the habit of smoking.
The film was very boring. -> The film was extremely tedious.
Houses are expensive. -> Housing costs are high.
She is good at maths. -> She has a talent for mathematics.
The government wants to reduce crime. -> The authorities aim to cut crime rates.
examples.ar: تهدف السلطات إلى خفض معدلات الجريمة.

examples.en: People use phones too much. -> Excessive phone use is common.
It rained a lot. -> There was heavy rainfall.
He was angry about the decision. -> He was furious at the decision.

rules.explanation_en: Use this, these, such, the former/the latter, and those who to refer back to earlier ideas and avoid repetition.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم this و these و such و the former/the latter و those who للإشارة إلى أفكار سابقة وتجنب التكرار.
rules.syntax: This/Such + noun. / The former ... the latter ...

examples.en: This shows that the plan works.
The former is cheaper; the latter is faster.
The company lost money. This led to job cuts.
examples.ar: خسرت الشركة مالًا. أدى ذلك إلى تسريح موظفين.

examples.en: In doing so, she saved time.
Another reason is cost. This is important too.
examples.ar: سبب آخر هو التكلفة. وهذا مهم أيضًا.

rules.explanation_en: Use furthermore, moreover, nevertheless, notwithstanding, consequently, thereby, hence and that said to link ideas in formal writing.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم furthermore و moreover و nevertheless و notwithstanding و consequently و thereby و hence و that said لربط الأفكار في الكتابة الرسمية.
rules.syntax: Linker, + clause. / Notwithstanding + noun.

examples.ar: علاوة على ذلك كانت النتائج إيجابية.
ومع ذلك لا تزال المشكلات قائمة.
على الرغم من التكلفة مضينا قدمًا.

examples.en: They cut costs, thereby saving money.
That said, the plan has merit.

rules.explanation_en: Turn verbs and adjectives into nouns to make writing more formal and compact: decide -> decision, rise -> rise, concerned -> concern.
rules.explanation_ar: نحول الأفعال والصفات إلى أسماء لتصبح الكتابة أكثر رسمية واختصارًا: decide -> decision و concerned -> concern.
rules.syntax: verb/adjective -> noun (the decision to..., the rise in...).

examples.en: We decided to increase prices. -> The decision to increase prices...
They developed a new method. -> The development of a new method...
Prices rose quickly. -> The rapid rise in prices...
People are concerned. -> There is growing concern.
The company expanded. -> The expansion of the company...
Many people disagree. -> There is widespread disagreement.
The government reacted slowly. -> The government's slow reaction...
They investigated the cause. -> An investigation into the cause...
Students improved. -> An improvement in student results...
We failed to agree. -> Our failure to agree...

rules.explanation_en: Academic writing packs information into noun phrases: determiner + adjectives + noun + of/in/into + noun. This avoids long sentences.
rules.explanation_ar: الكتابة الأكاديمية تحشد المعلومات في عبارات اسمية: محدد + صفات + اسم + of/in/into + اسم. وهذا يتجنب الجمل الطويلة.
rules.syntax: determiner + adjective + noun + prepositional phrase.

examples.en: The rapid growth of cities in developing countries is a major issue.
examples.ar: النمو السريع للمدن في الدول النامية قضية رئيسية.

examples.en: A significant increase in the number of students was reported.
examples.ar: أُفيد بزيادة كبيرة في عدد الطلاب.

examples.en: The introduction of new technology has changed work.
examples.ar: أدى إدخال التكنولوجيا الجديدة إلى تغيير العمل.

examples.en: Recent research into sleep has surprised scientists.
examples.ar: فاجأت الأبحاث الحديثة حول النوم العلماء.

examples.en: The availability of cheap flights has increased tourism.
A lack of clear evidence makes the claim doubtful.
examples.ar: غياب دليل واضح يجعل الادعاء مشكوكًا فيه.

examples.en: The rise in the cost of living worries families.
Public awareness of climate change is growing.
The implementation of the policy proved difficult.
The effectiveness of the treatment is still unclear.
examples.ar: لا تزال فعالية العلاج غير واضحة.

rules.explanation_en: Idioms are fixed phrases whose meaning is not literal. Use them in informal or semi-formal speech and do not change the words.
rules.explanation_ar: التعابير الاصطلاحية عبارات ثابتة معناها غير حرفي. نستخدمها في الكلام غير الرسمي أو شبه الرسمي ولا نغير كلماتها.
rules.syntax: Fixed phrase: verb + noun / prepositional phrase.

examples.en: He is the one who calls the shots.
We need to get the ball rolling.
He doesn't have two pennies to rub together.

rules.explanation_en: Many idioms describe emotions through images: over the moon (very happy), feeling blue (sad), green with envy (jealous).
rules.explanation_ar: كثير من التعابير تصف المشاعر بصور: over the moon (سعيد جدًا) و feeling blue (حزين) و green with envy (يحسد).
rules.syntax: be/feel + idiom.

examples.en: I'm at the end of my tether.
I was shaking like a leaf.
She kept a stiff upper lip.

rules.explanation_en: Some words belong together naturally: raise awareness, pose a threat, reach a consensus. Using the right partner makes your English sound natural.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الكلمات تلازم بعضها طبيعيًا: raise awareness و pose a threat و reach a consensus. واستخدام الشريك الصحيح يجعل لغتك طبيعية.
rules.syntax: verb + noun / adverb + adjective (fixed pairs).

examples.en: He has a great sense of humour.
You can draw your own conclusion.
You must take the cost into account.
examples.ar: يجب أن تأخذ التكلفة في الاعتبار.

rules.explanation_en: Binomials are fixed pairs of words joined by and or or. The order of the two words cannot be changed.
rules.explanation_ar: الثنائيات عبارات ثابتة من كلمتين تربطهما and أو or. ولا يمكن تغيير ترتيب الكلمتين.
rules.syntax: word A + and/or + word B (fixed order).

examples.en: I bought some odds and ends.
Let's weigh the pros and cons.
I learned by trial and error.
Life has its ups and downs.
Please be patient; we are doing our best, little by little.
examples.ar: يرجى الصبر؛ نبذل قصارى جهدنا شيئًا فشيئًا.

rules.explanation_en: Choose words that match the situation. Formal English prefers single Latin-based verbs to phrasal verbs.
rules.explanation_ar: نختار كلمات تناسب الموقف. الإنجليزية الرسمية تفضل أفعالًا مفردة ذات أصل لاتيني على الأفعال المركبة.
rules.syntax: get -> obtain, ask for -> request, find out -> discover, go up -> increase.

rules.explanation_en: In casual speech people use contractions and slang: gonna, wanna, dunno, gotta, no worries. Do not use them in formal writing.
rules.explanation_ar: في الكلام العادي يستخدم الناس اختصارات وعامية: gonna و wanna و dunno و gotta و no worries. ولا نستخدمها في الكتابة الرسمية.
rules.syntax: gonna = going to, wanna = want to, gotta = have got to.

examples.en: He's a bit of a pain.

rules.explanation_en: Indirect language sounds more polite: I wonder if you could..., Would it be possible to...? Do you happen to know...?
rules.explanation_ar: اللغة غير المباشرة تبدو أكثر أدبًا: I wonder if you could... و Would it be possible to...? و Do you happen to know...?
rules.syntax: I wonder if + clause. / Would it be possible to + verb?

examples.en: I wonder if you could help me.
Would it be possible to reschedule?
I was hoping you might lend me some money.
examples.ar: كنت آمل أن تقرضني بعض المال.

examples.en: Do you happen to know the time?
I don't suppose you could drive me?
It might be better if we waited.
examples.ar: ربما يكون من الأفضل أن ننتظر.

examples.en: I'd be grateful if you could confirm.
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Is there any chance you could come earlier?
examples.ar: هل هناك فرصة أن تأتي أبكر؟

rules.explanation_en: In irony the speaker means the opposite of the words. In understatement the speaker says less than is true. Tone of voice and context show the meaning.
rules.explanation_ar: في التهكم يقصد المتحدث عكس الكلمات. وفي التقليل من الشأن يقول المتحدث أقل من الحقيقة. وتوضح النبرة والسياق المعنى.
rules.syntax: Words + context = real meaning.

examples.en: That's just great! (when something goes wrong)
It's a bit chilly. (when it is minus ten)
examples.ar: الجو بارد قليلًا. (وهو عشر درجات تحت الصفر)

examples.en: He's not the sharpest tool in the box.
Well, that's one way to do it.

rules.explanation_en: In fast speech sounds join together and weaken. Informal spellings show this: gonna, wanna, gotta, kinda, dunno, lemme, gimme.
rules.explanation_ar: في الكلام السريع تتصل الأصوات وتضعف. والكتابة غير الرسمية تُظهر ذلك: gonna و wanna و gotta و kinda و dunno و lemme و gimme.
rules.syntax: going to -> gonna, want to -> wanna, got to -> gotta.

rules.explanation_en: Native speakers use fillers to think while speaking: well, you know, I mean, sort of, let me see. They keep the conversation going.
rules.explanation_ar: يستخدم المتحدثون الأصليون كلمات حشو ليفكروا أثناء الكلام: well و you know و I mean و sort of و let me see. وهي تُبقي المحادثة مستمرة.
rules.syntax: filler + clause.

examples.en: You know, it's not that simple.
examples.ar: كما تعلم الأمر ليس بهذه البساطة.

examples.en: As a matter of fact, I was there.
To be honest, I'm not sure.

examples.ar: على أي حال، كما كنت أقول...

rules.explanation_en: Some everyday words are different in British (UK) and American (US) English. Both are correct. Choose one and be consistent.
rules.explanation_ar: بعض الكلمات اليومية تختلف بين الإنجليزية البريطانية (UK) والأمريكية (US). وكلتاهما صحيحة. اختر واحدة والتزم بها.
rules.syntax: UK word / US word.

examples.en: lift (UK) / elevator (US): Take the lift to the third floor.
flat (UK) / apartment (US): I live in a small flat.
petrol (UK) / gas (US): We need to buy petrol.
lorry (UK) / truck (US): A lorry blocked the road.
biscuit (UK) / cookie (US): I'd like a biscuit with my tea.
pavement (UK) / sidewalk (US): Walk on the pavement.
boot (UK) / trunk (US): Put the bags in the boot.
rubbish (UK) / garbage (US): Take out the rubbish.
queue (UK) / line (US): There was a long queue.

rules.explanation_en: British spelling uses -our, -re, -ise; American uses -or, -er, -ize. Grammar differences include have got / have, at the weekend / on the weekend, and collective nouns.
rules.explanation_ar: الإملاء البريطاني يستخدم our و re و ise والأمريكي or و er و ize. ومن فروق القواعد have got / have و at the weekend / on the weekend والأسماء الجماعية.
rules.syntax: -our / -or, -re / -er, -ise / -ize.

examples.en: My favourite colour is blue. (UK: colour / US: color)
She lives in the city centre. (UK: centre / US: center)
I realise my mistake. (UK: realise / US: realize)
I love travelling. (UK: travelling / US: traveling)
See you at the weekend. (UK) / on the weekend (US)
He is in hospital. (UK) / in the hospital (US)
It is different from mine. (UK) / different than (US)
The team are playing well. (UK plural verb)

rules.explanation_en: Use phrases to change the topic, return to the topic, interrupt politely and take your turn.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم عبارات لتغيير الموضوع والعودة إليه والمقاطعة بأدب وأخذ دورنا.
rules.syntax: By the way, ... / Speaking of which, ... / Anyway, back to...

examples.en: By the way, did you hear the news?
Speaking of which, I have a question.
examples.ar: بمناسبة الحديث عن ذلك لدي سؤال.
على أي حال لنعد إلى الموضوع.

examples.en: To change the subject, how was your trip?
Going back to what you said earlier...
Let me just add one thing.
That reminds me, I have to call Sara.
examples.ar: هذا يذكرني، يجب أن أتصل بسارة.

rules.explanation_en: When you are not sure, use hedging phrases. To buy time to think, use phrases like That's a good question.
rules.explanation_ar: عندما لا تكون متأكدًا استخدم عبارات التحوط. ولتكسب وقتًا للتفكير استخدم عبارات مثل That's a good question.
rules.syntax: I'm not entirely sure, but... / Let me think about that.

examples.en: I'm not entirely sure, but I think so.
examples.ar: لست متأكدًا تمامًا لكنني أعتقد ذلك.

examples.en: If I remember rightly, it was in May.
examples.ar: إن لم تخني الذاكرة كان ذلك في مايو.

examples.en: Let me think about that for a moment.
As far as I know, it's open.
It depends on what you mean.
I haven't really thought about it.

rules.explanation_en: Persuasive speakers use rhetorical questions, direct appeals and strong but polite language.
rules.explanation_ar: المتحدثون المقنعون يستخدمون أسئلة بلاغية ونداءات مباشرة ولغة قوية لكن مهذبة.
rules.syntax: Surely + clause? / Don't you think + clause?

examples.en: Surely you agree that safety comes first?
examples.ar: بالتأكيد توافق على أن السلامة أولًا؟

examples.en: Don't you think it would be better to wait?
examples.ar: ألا تعتقد أنه من الأفضل أن ننتظر؟

examples.en: Wouldn't it make sense to save money?
examples.ar: ألن يكون من المنطقي أن نوفر المال؟

examples.en: You can't deny that it works.
Just imagine how much time we'd save.
examples.ar: تخيل فقط كم من الوقت سنوفر.

examples.en: What have we got to lose?

rules.explanation_en: To disagree without offence, use softening phrases: with respect, I'd question that, I'm not sure that follows.
rules.explanation_ar: لنخالف بدون إساءة نستخدم عبارات مخففة: with respect و I'd question that و I'm not sure that follows.
rules.syntax: With respect, + clause. / I'd question + noun.

examples.en: With respect, I think that's unfair.
examples.ar: مع كل الاحترام أعتقد أن ذلك غير عادل.

examples.en: I see your point, but surely...
Isn't that a bit of an oversimplification?
That's one way of looking at it.
examples.ar: هذه إحدى طرق النظر إلى الأمر.

rules.explanation_en: Writers often imply things without saying them directly. Words like at least, even, finally and only can show the writer's view.
rules.explanation_ar: غالبًا يلمّح الكتّاب إلى أشياء دون قولها مباشرة. وكلمات مثل at least و even و finally و only قد تكشف رأي الكاتب.
rules.syntax: Sentence (explicit) -> implied meaning.

examples.en: 'It's not the best restaurant I've been to.' -> It was disappointing.
examples.ar: ليس أفضل مطعم ذهبت إليه. -> كان مخيبًا للآمال.

examples.en: 'She finally replied to my email.' -> She was slow.
examples.ar: ردت أخيرًا على رسالتي. -> كانت بطيئة.

examples.en: 'He managed to pass.' -> It was difficult for him.
examples.ar: تمكن من النجاح. -> كان صعبًا عليه.

examples.en: 'At least it didn't rain.' -> The day had other problems.
examples.ar: على الأقل لم تمطر. -> كان لليوم مشكلات أخرى.

examples.en: 'They even invited me.' -> I didn't expect it.
examples.ar: حتى إنهم دعوني. -> لم أتوقع ذلك.

examples.en: 'I wouldn't call him honest.' -> He is dishonest.
examples.ar: لا أصفه بالصادق. -> هو غير صادق.

examples.en: 'Anyone could do that job.' -> The job is easy.
examples.ar: يمكن لأي أحد أداء تلك الوظيفة. -> الوظيفة سهلة.

examples.en: 'Her room is rather tidy for once.' -> It is usually messy.
examples.ar: غرفتها مرتبة نوعًا ما هذه المرة. -> هي عادة فوضوية.

examples.en: 'He only scored twice.' -> The writer thinks that is few.
examples.ar: لم يسجل سوى مرتين. -> يراه الكاتب قليلًا.

examples.en: 'Unfortunately, the plan worked.' -> The speaker disliked the plan.
examples.ar: للأسف نجحت الخطة. -> المتحدث لم تعجبه الخطة.

rules.explanation_en: Adverbs, verbs and adjectives show attitude: reluctantly, proudly, claim, admit, so-called, hailed. Notice them.
rules.explanation_ar: الظروف والأفعال والصفات تكشف الموقف: reluctantly و proudly و claim و admit و so-called و hailed. لاحظها.
rules.syntax: Attitude word + fact.

examples.en: The company claims to be green.
The scheme was hailed as a success.

rules.explanation_en: Words with similar meanings can be positive or negative. Writers choose them to influence the reader.
rules.explanation_ar: الكلمات المتقاربة في المعنى قد تكون إيجابية أو سلبية. ويختارها الكتّاب للتأثير في القارئ.
rules.syntax: Neutral / positive word vs negative word.

rules.explanation_en: Absolute claims sound certain: it is undeniable, everyone knows. Hedged claims are careful: seems, allegedly, arguably.
rules.explanation_ar: الادعاءات المطلقة تبدو مؤكدة: it is undeniable و everyone knows. والادعاءات المتحوطة حذرة: seems و allegedly و arguably.
rules.syntax: It is undeniable that... / It is arguably...

examples.en: It is undeniable that prices are rising.
examples.ar: لا يمكن إنكار أن الأسعار ترتفع.

examples.en: He is alleged to have stolen it.
It is obvious that the plan failed.
Without doubt, it is the best.
Experts agree that it is safe.

rules.explanation_en: An argument has a claim (the main point) and evidence (facts, examples, statistics). Ask: is the evidence enough?
rules.explanation_ar: الحجة فيها ادعاء (النقطة الرئيسية) ودليل (حقائق وأمثلة وإحصاءات). اسأل: هل الدليل كافٍ؟
rules.syntax: The author claims that... / The evidence suggests...

examples.en: The author claims that tourism helps.
For example, visitor numbers have doubled.
examples.ar: على سبيل المثال تضاعف عدد الزوار.

examples.en: This is supported by recent research.
The argument rests on one study.
The writer relies on personal experience.
The conclusion follows from the evidence.
The evidence does not support this claim.

rules.explanation_en: Look for weak reasoning: sweeping generalisations, oversimplification, ignoring other views, biased sources, and correlation confused with causation.
rules.explanation_ar: ابحث عن التفكير الضعيف: تعميمات شاملة وتبسيط مفرط وتجاهل الآراء الأخرى ومصادر متحيزة وخلط الارتباط بالسببية.
rules.syntax: This is a... / The argument overlooks...

examples.ar: تبسط الحجة القضية أكثر من اللازم.

examples.en: It assumes that all students are lazy.
The writer ignores the opposing view.
The sample is too small to draw conclusions.
examples.ar: العينة أصغر من أن تُستخلص منها نتائج.

examples.en: The claim is not backed up by evidence.

rules.explanation_en: Review the main C1 grammar: inversion, clefts, subjunctive, participle clauses, ellipsis and modal nuances.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة أهم قواعد C1: العكس والجمل المشقوقة والصيغة الشرطية الرسمية وجمل المشاركة والحذف ودقائق الأفعال الناقصة.
rules.syntax: Choose the structure that fits the emphasis and the register.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a view.
examples.ar: لم أرَ قط مثل هذا المنظر.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have helped.
I can swim and she can too.
I was going to call you.
Not only did he come, but he helped.

rules.explanation_en: Review academic style, idioms, register, speaking strategies and critical reading from this level.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة الأسلوب الأكاديمي والتعابير والمستويات اللغوية واستراتيجيات التحدث والقراءة النقدية في هذا المستوى.
rules.syntax: Match the language to the audience and purpose.

examples.en: The author argues that taxes should fall.
examples.ar: يجادل المؤلف بأن الضرائب ينبغي أن تنخفض.

examples.en: It could be argued that the plan failed.

examples.ar: مع كل الاحترام أشكك في ذلك.

examples.en: By the way, did you hear?

final_test.question: Never ___ such a beautiful view.
final_test.question_ar: لم أرَ قط مثل هذا المنظر الجميل.

final_test.question: ___ I known, I would have helped.
It ___ Ahmed who broke the window.
___ the work, she went home.
final_test.question_ar: بعد أن أنهت العمل ذهبت إلى المنزل.

final_test.question: I can swim and she ___ too.
I ___ call you, but I forgot.

rules.explanation_en: Near-synonyms differ in manner, speed, attitude or intensity. Choose the verb that shows exactly how an action happens.
rules.explanation_ar: المترادفات القريبة تختلف في الطريقة أو السرعة أو الموقف أو الشدة. نختار الفعل الذي يوضح بدقة كيف يحدث الفعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + precise verb + (manner) + object.

examples.en: He stared at the screen for hours.
They wandered around the old town.
examples.ar: تجولوا بلا هدف في البلدة القديمة.

rules.explanation_en: Words with the same basic meaning can carry positive or negative feelings. The choice shows the speaker's attitude.
rules.explanation_ar: الكلمات ذات المعنى الأساسي الواحد قد تحمل مشاعر إيجابية أو سلبية. واختيارها يُظهر موقف المتحدث.
rules.syntax: positive word / negative word with the same core meaning.

rules.explanation_en: Vary the length and structure of sentences. Use subordination, apposition, fronted adjectives, participles and short sentences for effect.
rules.explanation_ar: نُنوّع طول الجمل وبنيتها. نستخدم الجمل التابعة والبدل والصفات المتقدمة والمشاركات والجمل القصيرة للتأثير.
rules.syntax: Subordinate clause / apposition / participle / short sentence.

examples.en: Although she was exhausted, she kept working.
She was exhausted. She kept working.
Mr Hall, a retired teacher, lives next door.
examples.ar: السيد هول، وهو معلم متقاعد، يسكن بجوارنا.

examples.en: What surprised everyone was her calm.
The more he read, the less he understood.
Having failed twice, he tried again.
examples.ar: بعد أن فشل مرتين حاول مرة أخرى.

examples.en: It was not until midnight that the storm passed.
examples.ar: لم تمر العاصفة إلا بعد منتصف الليل.

examples.en: Rain fell. Wind howled. Night came.
examples.ar: هطل المطر. عوت الريح. حل الليل.

rules.explanation_en: The semicolon links related clauses, the colon introduces an explanation, dashes add emphasis or an aside, and brackets add extra information.
rules.explanation_ar: الفاصلة المنقوطة تربط جملتين متصلتين، والنقطتان تقدمان توضيحًا، والشرطة تضيف تأكيدًا أو استطرادًا، والأقواس تضيف معلومة إضافية.
rules.syntax: clause ; clause / statement : explanation / word - aside - word.

examples.en: She loves reading; he prefers films.
examples.ar: هي تحب القراءة؛ وهو يفضل الأفلام.

examples.en: There is one rule: be honest.
The house, which was empty, was sold.
We bought apples, pears, and plums.
The students' books were on the desk.

rules.explanation_en: C2 speakers use precise, less common words: ubiquitous, meticulous, ephemeral, pragmatic, ambiguous, inevitable, resilient, substantiate, exacerbate, mitigate.
rules.explanation_ar: يستخدم متحدثو C2 كلمات دقيقة أقل شيوعًا: ubiquitous و meticulous و ephemeral و pragmatic و ambiguous و inevitable و resilient و substantiate و exacerbate و mitigate.
rules.syntax: Learn the word with its collocations and example sentence.

examples.ar: الهواتف الذكية منتشرة في كل مكان.

rules.explanation_en: Many advanced words come from Latin and Greek roots: bio (life), tele (far), port (carry), spect (look), dict (say), ject (throw), scrib (write). Knowing them helps you guess new words.
rules.explanation_ar: كثير من الكلمات المتقدمة من جذور لاتينية ويونانية: bio (حياة) و tele (بعيد) و port (حمل) و spect (نظر) و dict (قال) و ject (رمى) و scrib (كتب). معرفتها تساعد على تخمين الكلمات الجديدة.
rules.syntax: prefix + root + suffix.

examples.en: Biology is the study of life.

rules.explanation_en: A metaphor says one thing is another (Life is a journey). A simile compares using like or as (as strong as an ox).
rules.explanation_ar: الاستعارة تقول إن شيئًا هو شيء آخر (Life is a journey). والتشبيه يقارن بـ like أو as (as strong as an ox).
rules.syntax: A is B. / A is as + adjective + as B. / A is like B.

examples.en: He is as strong as an ox.
Her voice was music to my ears.
The news hit him like a hammer.
Her smile was as bright as the sun.

rules.explanation_en: Personification gives human qualities to things. Metonymy replaces a thing with something related. Hyperbole is deliberate exaggeration.
rules.explanation_ar: التشخيص يعطي صفات بشرية للأشياء. والكناية المرسلة تستبدل شيئًا بما يرتبط به. والمبالغة تضخيم متعمد.
rules.syntax: thing + human verb. / related word for the whole. / extreme number or image.

examples.en: The wind whispered through the trees.
The pen is mightier than the sword.
The White House issued a statement.
I've told you a million times.
I'm so hungry I could eat a horse.
examples.ar: أنا جائع لدرجة أنني آكل حصانًا.

rules.explanation_en: Writers use flashback, foreshadowing, cliffhangers, free indirect speech and unreliable narrators to shape a story.
rules.explanation_ar: يستخدم الكتّاب الاسترجاع والتلميح المسبق والنهايات المعلقة والكلام غير المباشر الحر والرواة غير الموثوقين لتشكيل القصة.
rules.syntax: Technique + sentence example.

examples.en: As she walked, she remembered her childhood home. (flashback)
Little did he know it would be his last day. (foreshadowing)
examples.ar: لم يكن يعلم أنه سيكون آخر يوم له.

examples.en: The shots rang out before dawn. (in medias res)
Thoughts rushed: the letter, the road, the rain. (stream of consciousness)
The audience knew what he did not. (dramatic irony)
examples.ar: كان الجمهور يعرف ما لا يعرفه هو.

examples.en: He couldn't go. Not now. Not ever. (free indirect speech)
examples.ar: لم يستطع الذهاب. ليس الآن. ولا أبدًا.

examples.en: 'I am perfectly calm,' he said, shaking. (unreliable narrator)
examples.ar: قال وهو يرتجف: أنا هادئ تمامًا.

examples.en: The fog crept over the silent harbour. (setting)
It was then that everything changed. (climax)

rules.explanation_en: Literary English often uses inversion and fronting for effect: never before had..., so great was..., gone was..., scarcely had...
rules.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية الأدبية غالبًا تستخدم العكس والتقديم للتأثير: never before had... و so great was... و gone was... و scarcely had...
rules.syntax: Fronted phrase + inverted verb + subject.

examples.en: Never before had the village seen such a storm.
examples.ar: لم تشهد القرية قط عاصفة كهذه.

examples.en: Down the hill rolled the cart.
So great was her grief that she could not speak.
examples.ar: كان حزنها عظيمًا لدرجة أنها لم تستطع الكلام.

examples.en: Whilst he slept, the world changed.

examples.ar: لم يمض وقت طويل حتى خفت الضوء.

examples.en: Upon the hill stood a lonely tree.
Gone was the laughter of children.
Scarcely had she spoken when the lights died.
examples.ar: لم تكد تتكلم حتى انطفأت الأضواء.

examples.en: Such was the silence that a pin could be heard.
examples.ar: كان الصمت لدرجة أنه كان يمكن سماع سقوط دبوس.

rules.explanation_en: Legal English uses shall, hereby, notwithstanding, pursuant to, provided that and aforementioned. Sentences are long and precise.
rules.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية القانونية تستخدم shall و hereby و notwithstanding و pursuant to و provided that و aforementioned. والجمل طويلة ودقيقة.
rules.syntax: Subject + shall + verb. / Notwithstanding + noun, + clause.

examples.en: The tenant shall pay rent monthly.
Notwithstanding the above, the contract remains valid.
examples.ar: بصرف النظر عما سبق يظل العقد ساريًا.

examples.en: The parties hereby agree to the terms.
examples.ar: يوافق الطرفان بموجب هذا على الشروط.

examples.en: Pursuant to Article 5, the fee is due.
The undersigned declares that all details are true.
examples.ar: يقر الموقع أدناه بأن جميع التفاصيل صحيحة.

examples.en: In the event of a breach, the contract may be terminated.
examples.ar: في حال الإخلال يجوز إنهاء العقد.

examples.en: Provided that notice is given, the deposit will be refunded.
Liability is limited to the amount paid.
This agreement is governed by the law of the Kingdom.

rules.explanation_en: Scientific English uses the passive, nouns instead of verbs, and precise vocabulary. The agent is often not mentioned.
rules.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية العلمية تستخدم المبني للمجهول والأسماء بدل الأفعال ومفردات دقيقة. وغالبًا لا يُذكر الفاعل.
rules.syntax: Subject + was/were + past participle (+ by method).

examples.en: The samples were heated to 100 degrees.
The data were analysed using software.
The results are summarised in Table 2.
The device operates at low voltage.
Participants were randomly assigned to groups.

rules.rule: Long noun phrases and embedded clauses
