rules.explanation_en: Dense texts pack information into long noun phrases and embedded clauses. Find the main subject and main verb first, then add the rest.
rules.explanation_ar: النصوص الكثيفة تحشر المعلومات في عبارات اسمية طويلة وجمل مضمنة. ابحث عن الفاعل الرئيسي والفعل الرئيسي أولًا ثم أضف الباقي.
rules.syntax: noun + who/which/that clause + main verb.

examples.en: The rapid expansion of low-cost airlines has changed travel.
examples.ar: غير التوسع السريع لشركات الطيران منخفضة التكلفة السفر.

examples.en: The man who she believed had stolen her bag was innocent.
examples.ar: كان الرجل الذي ظنت أنه سرق حقيبتها بريئًا.

examples.en: What he said about the plan surprised us.
The fact that he lied bothered everyone.
The question of whether to resign remains open.
The report, which took months to write, was rejected.
examples.ar: رُفض التقرير الذي استغرقت كتابته أشهرًا.

examples.en: Her decision to leave, though understandable, shocked us.
examples.ar: قرارها بالمغادرة، رغم أنه مفهوم، صدمنا.

examples.en: The extent to which prices will rise is unclear.
It is the people who live there who suffer.
examples.ar: الناس الذين يعيشون هناك هم من يعانون.

examples.en: The reason why he refused is unknown.

rules.explanation_en: Advanced writers use given that, insofar as, whatever, whether or not, be that as it may, much as and however + adjective to express complex relations.
rules.explanation_ar: يستخدم الكتّاب المتقدمون given that و insofar as و whatever و whether or not و be that as it may و much as و however + صفة للتعبير عن علاقات معقدة.
rules.syntax: Given that + clause, ... / However + adjective + subject + verb, ...

examples.en: Despite the fact that costs rose, profits increased.
Given that time is short, we should begin.
examples.ar: بما أن الوقت ضيق ينبغي أن نبدأ.

examples.en: Insofar as the data allow, we can conclude this.
examples.ar: بقدر ما تسمح البيانات يمكننا استنتاج ذلك.

examples.en: Provided that funding is secured, work will begin.
Insofar as it matters, I agree.
Whatever the reason, the result is the same.
Whether or not he agrees, we will proceed.
examples.ar: سواء وافق أم لا سنمضي قدمًا.

examples.en: Be that as it may, we must act.
examples.ar: مهما يكن الأمر علينا أن نتصرف.

examples.en: Much as I admire her, I cannot support this.
examples.ar: مهما أُعجب بها لا أستطيع دعم هذا.

examples.en: However hard he tried, he failed.

rules.explanation_en: Summarise by identifying the central point and the key support, and then restating them briefly in your own words.
rules.explanation_ar: نلخص بتحديد النقطة المحورية والدعم الرئيسي ثم إعادة صياغتهما باختصار بكلماتنا.
rules.syntax: In essence, ... / The central point is that...

examples.en: In essence, the article argues that cities need green space.
examples.ar: في جوهره يجادل المقال بأن المدن تحتاج إلى مساحات خضراء.

examples.en: The central point is that cities need parks.
examples.ar: النقطة المحورية أن المدن تحتاج إلى حدائق.

examples.en: Broadly speaking, the author supports reform.
The text can be summed up as follows.
The main thrust of the argument is economic.
The writer's key claim is that growth is limited.
examples.ar: الادعاء الرئيسي للكاتب أن النمو محدود.

examples.en: Stripped of detail, the message is simple.
examples.ar: بعد تجريده من التفاصيل الرسالة بسيطة.

examples.en: All in all, the report is optimistic.
To put it briefly, the plan failed.

rules.explanation_en: Choose reporting verbs that show the writer's attitude: concede, challenge, dismiss, corroborate, contend, acknowledge, refute, endorse.
rules.explanation_ar: نختار أفعال نقل تُظهر موقف الكاتب: concede و challenge و dismiss و corroborate و contend و acknowledge و refute و endorse.
rules.syntax: The author + stance verb + (that) + clause.

examples.en: The author concedes that costs are high.
She challenges the view that growth is good.
examples.ar: هي تتحدى الرأي القائل إن النمو جيد.

examples.en: He contends that taxes should fall.
examples.ar: يؤكد أن الضرائب ينبغي أن تنخفض.

examples.en: The author is sceptical about the claim.
The article implies that blame lies elsewhere.
examples.ar: يلمح المقال إلى أن اللوم يقع على غيرنا.

rules.explanation_en: Anaphora repeats words at the start of sentences. A tricolon is a group of three. Both create rhythm and memorability.
rules.explanation_ar: التكرار الاستهلالي يكرر كلمات في بداية الجمل. والثلاثية مجموعة من ثلاثة عناصر. وكلاهما يخلق إيقاعًا وسهولة في التذكر.
rules.syntax: X, X, X. / A, B, and C.

examples.en: We will not give up. We will not give in. We will not go back.
examples.ar: لن نستسلم. لن نرضخ. لن نعود.

examples.en: Better schools, better jobs, better lives.
examples.ar: مدارس أفضل ووظائف أفضل وحياة أفضل.

examples.en: Every child deserves a chance; every child deserves a voice; every child deserves a future.
examples.ar: كل طفل يستحق فرصة وكل طفل يستحق صوتًا وكل طفل يستحق مستقبلًا.

examples.en: Veni, vidi, vici: I came, I saw, I conquered.
We work hard, we play hard, we live hard.
examples.ar: نعمل بجد ونلعب بجد ونعيش بجد.

rules.explanation_en: Antithesis puts opposite ideas in parallel structure. A rhetorical question is asked for effect, not for an answer.
rules.explanation_ar: الطباق يضع فكرتين متضادتين في بنية متوازية. والسؤال البلاغي يُطرح للتأثير لا لانتظار إجابة.
rules.syntax: not X but Y. / Question for effect.

examples.en: To err is human; to forgive, divine.
examples.ar: الخطأ من طبيعة البشر والغفران من الإلهي.

examples.en: It is not what you say but how you say it.
examples.ar: المهم ليس ما تقوله بل كيف تقوله.

examples.en: We are not asking for charity; we are demanding justice.
examples.ar: لا نطلب إحسانًا بل نطالب بالعدالة.

examples.en: Easy to start, hard to finish.
Many are called, but few are chosen.
Who will speak if we stay silent?
Is this the world we want?
examples.ar: هل هذا هو العالم الذي نريده؟

examples.en: Are we really going to accept this?

rules.explanation_en: Ethos appeals to credibility, pathos to emotion, and logos to logic and evidence. Good persuasion uses all three.
rules.explanation_ar: الإيتوس يخاطب المصداقية، والباثوس العاطفة، واللوغوس المنطق والدليل. والإقناع الجيد يستخدم الثلاثة.
rules.syntax: Ethos: credibility. Pathos: emotion. Logos: evidence.

examples.en: As a doctor with twenty years of experience, I can tell you this. (ethos)
examples.ar: بصفتي طبيبًا بخبرة عشرين عامًا أستطيع أن أقول لكم هذا.

examples.en: You can trust me; I have no interest in profit. (ethos)
examples.ar: يمكنكم الوثوق بي؛ فليس لدي مصلحة في الربح.

examples.en: Imagine a child going to bed hungry. (pathos)
Think of the families who have lost everything. (pathos)
examples.ar: فكروا في الأسر التي فقدت كل شيء.

examples.en: Studies show that 80 per cent of people agree. (logos)
If prices rise, demand falls; therefore, we should wait. (logos)
examples.ar: إذا ارتفعت الأسعار انخفض الطلب؛ لذلك ينبغي أن ننتظر.

examples.en: I have lived here all my life. (ethos)
It breaks my heart to see this. (pathos)
The evidence is clear and consistent. (logos)

rules.explanation_en: Persuaders frame the issue as urgent, moral or shared: we can't afford to ignore this, it is our duty, we owe it to future generations.
rules.explanation_ar: يؤطر المقنعون القضية على أنها عاجلة أو أخلاقية أو مشتركة: we can't afford to ignore this و it is our duty و we owe it to future generations.
rules.syntax: We can't afford to... / It is our duty to... / Only by... can we...

examples.en: We can't afford to ignore this.
The time to act is now.
Only by working together can we succeed.
Think of what we stand to gain.
Nobody wants to see this happen again.
examples.ar: لا أحد يريد رؤية ذلك يتكرر.

examples.en: It is our duty to act.
We owe it to future generations.
Doing nothing is not an option.
Surely we can all agree on this.
examples.ar: بالتأكيد يمكننا جميعًا الاتفاق على هذا.

rules.explanation_en: Verbal irony says the opposite of what is meant. Sarcasm is irony used to mock or criticise. Situational irony is when the outcome is the opposite of what is expected.
rules.explanation_ar: التهكم اللفظي يقول عكس المقصود. والسخرية تهكم يُستخدم للاستهزاء أو النقد. ومفارقة الموقف هي أن تكون النتيجة عكس المتوقع.
rules.syntax: Positive words + negative situation = irony.

examples.en: What a lovely day! (in the pouring rain)
examples.ar: يا له من يوم جميل! (في المطر الغزير)

examples.en: Thanks for your help! (when someone didn't help)
It's not like I wanted to sleep anyway.
examples.ar: لم أكن أريد النوم على أي حال.

examples.en: The fire station burned down. (situational irony)
A traffic jam on the way to the traffic office.
examples.ar: ازدحام مروري في الطريق إلى إدارة المرور.

examples.en: I love waiting in line for hours. (sarcastic)

rules.explanation_en: Puns play on words with double meanings. Dry wit is humour delivered with a serious face and understatement.
rules.explanation_ar: التورية تلعب بكلمات ذات معنيين. والفكاهة الجافة تُقدم بوجه جاد وتقليل من الشأن.
rules.syntax: Double meaning + straight delivery.

examples.en: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
examples.ar: الزمن يطير كالسهم وذباب الفاكهة يحب الموز.

examples.en: I used to be a banker, but I lost interest.
examples.ar: كنت مصرفيًا لكنني فقدت الاهتمام (وفقدت الفائدة).

examples.en: I'm reading a book on anti-gravity; it's impossible to put down.
examples.ar: أقرأ كتابًا عن انعدام الجاذبية يستحيل تركه.

examples.en: Why was the maths book sad? It had too many problems.
examples.ar: لماذا كان كتاب الرياضيات حزينًا؟ لديه مشكلات كثيرة.

examples.en: A dentist's job is full of drills.
I'm not lazy; I'm in energy-saving mode.
examples.ar: لست كسولًا؛ أنا في وضع توفير الطاقة.

examples.en: I'd agree with you, but then we'd both be wrong.
examples.ar: كنت سأتفق معك لكننا حينها سنكون مخطئين معًا.

examples.en: The Sahara is a little warm in summer. (understatement)
I have a few emails. (there are two thousand)

rules.explanation_en: Open a speech with a question, a story, a surprising fact or a vivid image to capture attention.
rules.explanation_ar: نفتتح الخطبة بسؤال أو قصة أو حقيقة مفاجئة أو صورة حية لجذب الانتباه.
rules.syntax: Imagine... / Did you know that...? / Let me begin with...

examples.en: Let me begin with a question.
Ten years ago, I stood where you are sitting.
examples.ar: قبل عشر سنوات وقفت حيث تجلسون.

examples.en: Did you know that 70 per cent of the Earth is water?
examples.ar: هل تعلمون أن 70 بالمئة من الأرض ماء؟

examples.en: I'd like to tell you a short story.
examples.ar: أود أن أحكي لكم قصة قصيرة.

examples.en: Close your eyes for a moment.
Today I want to challenge a common belief.
We are here for one reason.
What if everything you knew was wrong?
examples.ar: ماذا لو كان كل ما تعرفونه خاطئًا؟

examples.en: It is an honour to speak to you today.
examples.ar: إنه لشرف أن أتحدث إليكم اليوم.

rules.explanation_en: End with a clear message and a call to action: ask the audience to do or think something specific.
rules.explanation_ar: ننهي برسالة واضحة ودعوة إلى العمل: نطلب من الجمهور أن يفعل أو يفكر في شيء محدد.
rules.syntax: Let us + verb. / I ask you to + verb.

examples.en: So where do we go from here?
I ask you to join me.
Let us act, and let us act now.
Together, we can make a difference.
In closing, remember this: small steps matter.
examples.ar: في الختام تذكروا هذا: الخطوات الصغيرة مهمة.

examples.en: Thank you, and let's get to work.
The future belongs to those who prepare for it.
Don't wait for change; be the change.
examples.ar: لا تنتظر التغيير بل كن التغيير.

examples.en: I leave you with one question.

rules.explanation_en: Mediation means passing on the meaning in a form suitable for the listener. Change formal wording into natural, everyday speech without losing the message.
rules.explanation_ar: الوساطة تعني نقل المعنى بصيغة تناسب المستمع. نحوّل الصياغة الرسمية إلى كلام يومي طبيعي دون فقدان الرسالة.
rules.syntax: Formal phrase -> everyday phrase.

examples.en: Please be advised that the office will be closed. -> Just so you know, the office is closed.
examples.ar: الرجاء العلم أن المكتب سيكون مغلقًا. -> للعلم فقط المكتب مغلق.

examples.en: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful. -> Sorry, but you didn't get the job.
examples.ar: يؤسفنا إبلاغكم أن طلبكم لم ينجح. -> آسف لكنك لم تحصل على الوظيفة.

examples.en: I would appreciate your prompt response. -> Get back to me soon, please.
examples.ar: سأقدر ردكم السريع. -> رد علي قريبًا من فضلك.

examples.en: The individual in question was apprehended. -> The guy was arrested.
Kindly refrain from smoking. -> Please don't smoke.
examples.ar: يرجى الامتناع عن التدخين. -> من فضلك لا تدخن.

examples.en: We shall endeavour to resolve the matter. -> We'll try to sort it out.
It is imperative that you attend. -> You really need to come.
examples.ar: من الضروري أن تحضر. -> تحتاج حقًا أن تأتي.

examples.en: The product is no longer available. -> We've run out.
Prior to departure, please ensure the windows are closed. -> Before you leave, make sure the windows are shut.
examples.ar: قبل المغادرة تأكد من إغلاق النوافذ. -> قبل أن تغادر تأكد أن النوافذ مغلقة.

examples.en: He is in possession of the keys. -> He's got the keys.

rules.explanation_en: Simplify dense language for a non-expert: replace abstract nouns with verbs, long words with short ones, and explain technical ideas in plain words.
rules.explanation_ar: نبسط اللغة الكثيفة لغير المتخصص: نستبدل الأسماء المجردة بأفعال والكلمات الطويلة بقصيرة ونشرح الأفكار التقنية بكلمات بسيطة.
rules.syntax: Complex phrase -> plain phrase.

examples.en: The rate of inflation has escalated. -> Prices are rising faster.
examples.ar: ارتفع معدل التضخم. -> الأسعار ترتفع أسرع.

examples.en: Individuals who fail to comply will be penalised. -> If you don't follow the rules, you'll be fined.
examples.ar: سيُعاقب الأفراد الذين لا يمتثلون. -> إن لم تتبع القواعد ستُغرّم.

examples.en: The establishment is currently non-operational. -> The place is closed now.
examples.ar: المنشأة غير عاملة حاليًا. -> المكان مغلق الآن.

examples.en: Remuneration is commensurate with experience. -> Pay depends on your experience.
examples.ar: الأجر يتناسب مع الخبرة. -> الراتب يعتمد على خبرتك.

examples.en: He exhibited reluctance to participate. -> He didn't want to join in.
examples.ar: أبدى ترددًا في المشاركة. -> لم يرد المشاركة.

examples.en: The majority concurred. -> Most people agreed.
Insufficient funds prevented completion. -> There wasn't enough money to finish.
examples.ar: حال نقص الأموال دون الإكمال. -> لم يكن هناك مال كافٍ للإنهاء.

examples.en: We anticipate a delay. -> We think it'll be late.
The vehicle was stationary. -> The car wasn't moving.
examples.ar: كانت المركبة ساكنة. -> السيارة لم تكن تتحرك.

examples.en: Commence the procedure. -> Start the process.

rules.explanation_en: Adjust vocabulary, tone and formality to the listener: customer, colleague, manager, friend, child, public, expert.
rules.explanation_ar: نعدّل المفردات والنبرة والرسمية حسب المستمع: عميل أو زميل أو مدير أو صديق أو طفل أو جمهور أو خبير.
rules.syntax: Same idea, different register.

examples.en: We apologise for the inconvenience. (to a customer)
Sorry about the mix-up. (to a colleague)
I'd like to flag a concern. (to a manager)
Let's tidy up, okay? (to a child)
We'd be delighted to assist. (to a client)
Residents are advised to stay indoors. (to the public)
Excuse me, could you help me? (to a stranger)
Could you elaborate on the methodology? (to an expert)

rules.explanation_en: Soften difficult messages with hedges and indirect phrases so that the other person is not offended.
rules.explanation_ar: نخفف الرسائل الصعبة بعبارات تحوط وغير مباشرة حتى لا يشعر الطرف الآخر بالإساءة.
rules.syntax: I'm afraid... / It might be worth... / I wonder whether...

examples.en: With the greatest respect, I think there may be a misunderstanding.
examples.ar: مع كل الاحترام أعتقد أنه قد يكون هناك سوء فهم.

examples.en: I'm afraid we won't be able to proceed.

examples.ar: قد يكون من المفيد إعادة النظر.

examples.en: I wonder whether we could look at this differently.
examples.ar: أتساءل إن كان بإمكاننا النظر إلى هذا بشكل مختلف.

examples.en: Perhaps I haven't made myself clear.
That's not quite how I see it.
Would it be fair to say that...?
I hear what you're saying, but...
Let's try to find common ground.

rules.explanation_en: When you pass on someone's words, use reporting structures and keep the meaning accurate: She says that..., He asked me to tell you..., According to...
rules.explanation_ar: عندما ننقل كلام شخص نستخدم تراكيب النقل ونحافظ على دقة المعنى: She says that... و He asked me to tell you... و According to...
rules.syntax: She says (that) + clause. / He asked me to tell you + clause.

examples.en: She says that the meeting has been moved.
He asked me to tell you he'll be late.
examples.ar: طلب مني أن أخبرك أنه سيتأخر.

examples.en: The manager wants to know whether you can start on Monday.
examples.ar: يريد المدير أن يعرف هل يمكنك البدء يوم الاثنين.

examples.en: According to the guide, the museum closes at five.
examples.ar: بحسب الدليل يغلق المتحف في الخامسة.

examples.en: They're asking if the room is available.
He says he doesn't understand the question.
She'd like to know where the toilets are.
examples.ar: تود أن تعرف أين دورات المياه.

examples.en: The speaker is saying that costs have doubled.
He mentioned that he'd already paid.

rules.explanation_en: Explain cultural ideas and customs so that people from another culture understand them. Use comparisons and neutral language.
rules.explanation_ar: نشرح الأفكار والعادات الثقافية ليفهمها أشخاص من ثقافة أخرى. نستخدم المقارنات ولغة محايدة.
rules.syntax: In X culture, ... / It is similar to ... in that ...

examples.en: In Saudi culture, coffee is a sign of hospitality.
examples.ar: في الثقافة السعودية القهوة علامة ضيافة.

examples.en: Friday is the day when families gather.
examples.ar: الجمعة هي اليوم الذي تجتمع فيه الأسر.

examples.en: Eid is similar to Christmas in that families gather.
examples.ar: العيد يشبه الكريسمس في اجتماع الأسر.

examples.en: Insha'Allah means 'God willing' and is often used politely.
examples.ar: تعني إن شاء الله 'إن أراد الله' وتُستخدم غالبًا بأدب.

examples.en: Tea is served as a gesture of welcome.
In some cultures, saying no directly is considered rude.
examples.ar: في بعض الثقافات يُعد قول لا مباشرة وقحًا.

examples.en: Eating with the right hand is customary here.
Greeting with a handshake is common in business.
It is polite to remove your shoes.
Punctuality matters more in some countries than in others.
examples.ar: الالتزام بالمواعيد أهم في بعض الدول من غيرها.

rules.explanation_en: Check understanding by paraphrasing what the other person said and asking for confirmation.
rules.explanation_ar: نتحقق من الفهم بإعادة صياغة كلام الطرف الآخر وطلب التأكيد.
rules.syntax: If I've got this right, you...? / Are you saying that...?

examples.en: Let me make sure I've understood: you want it by Friday?
examples.ar: دعني أتأكد أنني فهمت: تريده بحلول الجمعة؟

examples.en: What I understood is that the budget is fixed.
examples.ar: ما فهمته هو أن الميزانية ثابتة.

examples.en: So, to sum up, we agree on two points.
If I've got this right, you're proposing a delay.
examples.ar: إن كنت فهمت صحيحًا فأنت تقترح تأجيلًا.

examples.en: Just to clarify, who is responsible?
Are you saying that we should cancel?
examples.ar: هل تقول إنه ينبغي أن نلغي؟

examples.en: Could you spell out what you mean?
examples.ar: هل يمكنك توضيح ما تقصد بالتفصيل؟

examples.en: So what you're suggesting is a compromise?
examples.ar: إذن ما تقترحه هو حل وسط؟

examples.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but...

rules.explanation_en: When there is a misunderstanding, stay calm, take responsibility, and reformulate your message.
rules.explanation_ar: عند حدوث سوء فهم نبقى هادئين ونتحمل المسؤولية ونعيد صياغة رسالتنا.
rules.syntax: Let me rephrase that. / What I meant was...

examples.en: I think we've been talking at cross purposes.
examples.ar: أعتقد أننا نتحدث عن أمرين مختلفين.

examples.en: Perhaps I didn't express myself clearly.
examples.ar: ربما لم أعبر عن نفسي بوضوح.

examples.en: What I meant to say was...
Can we go back a step?
We seem to be on different pages.
examples.ar: يبدو أننا لسنا على الصفحة نفسها.

examples.en: Let's start again from the beginning.
I see where the confusion arose.

rules.explanation_en: Slang is informal language used among friends. It changes quickly and may sound rude in formal settings. Use it carefully.
rules.explanation_ar: العامية لغة غير رسمية بين الأصدقاء. تتغير بسرعة وقد تبدو غير مهذبة في المواقف الرسمية. نستخدمها بحذر.
rules.syntax: Slang word / phrase (informal only).

examples.en: She's got a lot of guts.

rules.explanation_en: Spoken English uses many informal phrasal verbs: hang out, chill out, catch up, hit the road, wing it, end up, show off, sleep on it.
rules.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية المحكية تستخدم أفعالًا مركبة غير رسمية كثيرة: hang out و chill out و catch up و hit the road و wing it و end up و show off و sleep on it.
rules.syntax: verb + particle (informal).

examples.en: I'll catch up with you later.

rules.explanation_en: English has regional words in Australia, Ireland, Scotland and Britain. You do not need to use them, but you should understand them.
rules.explanation_ar: للإنجليزية كلمات إقليمية في أستراليا وأيرلندا واسكتلندا وبريطانيا. لا يلزم أن تستخدمها لكن ينبغي أن تفهمها.
rules.syntax: Regional word = standard meaning.

examples.en: What's the craic? (Irish: what's the news?)
See you in a fortnight. (UK: two weeks)
I'm chuffed to bits. (UK: very pleased)

rules.explanation_en: Dialects have different grammar: y'all (you plural), ain't, innit, was with plural subjects. These are non-standard and not used in formal English.
rules.explanation_ar: اللهجات لها قواعد مختلفة: y'all و ain't و innit واستخدام was مع الجمع. هذه غير معيارية ولا تُستخدم في الإنجليزية الرسمية.
rules.syntax: Non-standard form (recognise, do not copy in formal writing).

examples.en: She's going to the shops, eh? (Canadian)
examples.ar: إنها ذاهبة إلى المحلات، أليس كذلك؟

rules.explanation_en: Proverbs are short sayings that give advice or a general truth. Use them sparingly to sound natural.
rules.explanation_ar: الأمثال أقوال قصيرة تعطي نصيحة أو حقيقة عامة. نستخدمها باعتدال لنبدو طبيعيين.
rules.syntax: Fixed saying (do not change the words).

examples.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
examples.ar: غرزة في وقتها تغني عن تسع.

examples.en: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
examples.ar: لا تعد الدجاج قبل أن يفقس.

examples.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
The early bird catches the worm.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
examples.ar: لم تُبنَ روما في يوم واحد.

examples.en: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
examples.ar: لا تحكم على الكتاب من غلافه.

examples.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
examples.ar: إذا كنت في روما فافعل كما يفعل الرومان.

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

rules.explanation_en: An allusion is an indirect reference to a story, person or event that the audience knows: Achilles' heel, Pandora's box, catch-22.
rules.explanation_ar: الإشارة الضمنية مرجع غير مباشر إلى قصة أو شخص أو حدث يعرفه الجمهور: Achilles' heel و Pandora's box و catch-22.
rules.syntax: Famous name + idea (a/an + allusion).

examples.ar: إنه موقف مأزق لا مخرج منه.

examples.en: This is a David and Goliath battle.

rules.explanation_en: At C2 you should understand and use idioms naturally in the right context: fish out of water, same boat, tip of the iceberg, last straw.
rules.explanation_ar: في C2 ينبغي أن تفهم التعابير وتستخدمها بطبيعية في السياق الصحيح: fish out of water و same boat و tip of the iceberg و last straw.
rules.syntax: Fixed idiom (do not change words).

examples.en: He's a fish out of water.
It's the tip of the iceberg.
She's burning the candle at both ends.

examples.ar: هذه القشة التي قصمت ظهر البعير.

examples.en: He bit off more than he could chew.
I'll cross that bridge when I come to it.
examples.ar: سأتعامل مع ذلك عندما يحين وقته.

rules.explanation_en: Euphemisms are polite or indirect words used instead of harsh or embarrassing ones: pass away (die), between jobs (unemployed), let go (fire).
rules.explanation_ar: التلطيفات كلمات مهذبة أو غير مباشرة تُستخدم بدل كلمات قاسية أو محرجة: pass away (يموت) و between jobs (عاطل) و let go (يفصل).
rules.syntax: polite phrase instead of a direct word.

examples.en: The company is going through a restructuring.
She is economical with the truth.

rules.explanation_en: Academic abstracts use the present or past simple, passive and precise verbs: investigate, adopt, indicate, comprise, warrant.
rules.explanation_ar: الملخصات الأكاديمية تستخدم المضارع أو الماضي البسيط والمبني للمجهول وأفعالًا دقيقة: investigate و adopt و indicate و comprise و warrant.
rules.syntax: This paper + verb + object. / Findings indicate that...

examples.en: This paper investigates the effect of sleep on memory.
examples.ar: تبحث هذه الورقة أثر النوم في الذاكرة.

examples.en: The study adopts a mixed-methods approach.
The results have implications for policy.

examples.ar: هناك ما يبرر إجراء مزيد من البحث.

examples.en: The limitations of the study are discussed.
This article contributes to the debate on education.
examples.ar: تسهم هذه المقالة في النقاش حول التعليم.

examples.en: The author concludes that reform is needed.
examples.ar: يخلص المؤلف إلى أن الإصلاح مطلوب.

rules.explanation_en: Cut wordy phrases: in order to -> to, due to the fact that -> because, at this point in time -> now. Short, clear writing is more powerful.
rules.explanation_ar: نحذف العبارات المطولة: in order to -> to و due to the fact that -> because و at this point in time -> now. والكتابة القصيرة الواضحة أقوى.
rules.syntax: wordy phrase -> short phrase.

examples.en: in order to -> to: We study to learn.
due to the fact that -> because: He left because it was late.
at this point in time -> now: We can't decide now.
in the event that -> if: If it rains, we'll stay.
a large number of -> many: Many people came.
despite the fact that -> although: Although he was ill, he came.
with regard to -> about: Let's talk about the plan.
each and every -> every: Every student passed.
completely finished -> finished: The work is finished.
basic fundamentals -> fundamentals: Learn the fundamentals.

rules.explanation_en: Use signposting language to guide the audience through your main points, examples and recaps.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم عبارات التوجيه لإرشاد الجمهور عبر نقاطك الرئيسية والأمثلة والملخصات.
rules.syntax: Today I'll make three points. / This brings me to...

examples.en: Let me start with the big picture.
This brings me to my second point.
To illustrate, let me share an example.
Before I move on, a quick recap.
What does this mean for us?
Let me put that in perspective.
And that leads me to my final point.

rules.explanation_en: Respond to questions with confidence: acknowledge the question, check understanding, and be honest about what you do not know.
rules.explanation_ar: نرد على الأسئلة بثقة: نقر بالسؤال ونتحقق من الفهم ونكون صادقين بشأن ما لا نعرفه.
rules.syntax: That's a good question. / If I understand you correctly...

examples.en: If I understand you correctly, you're asking about cost.
examples.ar: إن فهمتك بشكل صحيح فأنت تسأل عن التكلفة.

examples.en: I'm afraid I don't have the figures to hand.
examples.ar: أخشى أنه ليس لدي الأرقام الآن.

examples.en: Let me get back to you on that.
That's outside the scope of today's talk.
We have time for one more question.

rules.explanation_en: Use professional terms: walk-away point, room to manoeuvre, concession, counter-offer, win-win, in writing.
rules.explanation_ar: نستخدم مصطلحات مهنية: walk-away point و room to manoeuvre و concession و counter-offer و win-win و in writing.
rules.syntax: We're willing to... / Let's explore...

examples.en: We have some room to manoeuvre.
We're willing to make a concession on price.
examples.ar: نحن مستعدون لتقديم تنازل في السعر.

examples.en: We'd like to put forward a counter-offer.

examples.ar: هذا عرض إما أن تقبله أو ترفضه.

rules.explanation_en: Stay calm, show understanding, separate the problem from the person, and propose a way forward.
rules.explanation_ar: نبقى هادئين ونُظهر التفهم ونفصل المشكلة عن الشخص ونقترح طريقًا للمضي قدمًا.
rules.syntax: I understand... / Let's focus on... / I'd like to propose...

examples.en: Let's focus on the issue, not the person.
I understand where you're coming from.

examples.ar: هل يمكننا أن نتفق على الاختلاف؟

examples.en: I'd like to propose a way forward.
examples.ar: أود أن أقترح طريقًا للمضي قدمًا.

examples.en: We seem to want the same outcome.
Let's not let this damage our relationship.
I'd be happy to revisit this later.

rules.explanation_en: Review precise word choice, figurative language, literary and legal style, academic writing and register.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة اختيار الكلمات الدقيق واللغة المجازية والأسلوب الأدبي والقانوني والكتابة الأكاديمية والمستوى اللغوي.
rules.syntax: Choose the word and structure that fit the audience and purpose.

examples.en: The tenant shall pay the rent.
It is not what you say but how you say it.
examples.ar: المهم ليس ما تقوله بل كيف تقوله.

examples.en: The wind whispered through the trees.
Notwithstanding the above, the contract stands.
examples.ar: رغم ما سبق يظل العقد قائمًا.

examples.en: Never before had we seen such a storm.

rules.explanation_en: Review persuasion, mediation, negotiation and native-like expressions from this level.
rules.explanation_ar: مراجعة الإقناع والوساطة والتفاوض والتعبيرات الشبيهة بالناطقين الأصليين في هذا المستوى.
rules.syntax: Match the strategy to the situation.

examples.en: We will not give up. We will not give in.
If I've got this right, you want a delay.
examples.ar: إن فهمت صحيحًا فأنت تريد تأجيلًا.

examples.en: I think we've been talking at cross purposes.
examples.ar: أعتقد أننا نتحدث عن أمرين مختلفين.

examples.en: With respect, I see it differently.
examples.ar: مع كل الاحترام أراه بشكل مختلف.

examples.en: Only by working together can we succeed.
We have some room to manoeuvre.
A stitch in time saves nine.
examples.ar: غرزة في وقتها تغني عن تسع.

examples.en: Thank you, and let's get to work.

final_test.question: She ___ at the screen for hours.
___ had the village seen such a storm.
final_test.question_ar: لم تشهد القرية قط عاصفة كهذه.

final_test.question: Saying 'What a lovely day!' in pouring rain is ___.
final_test.question_ar: قول يا له من يوم جميل في المطر تهكم.

final_test.question: 'We regret to inform you' is ___ language.
'A stitch in time saves nine' is a ___.
'In order to' can be shortened to ___.
final_test.question_ar: يمكن اختصار in order to إلى to.
